zh_source:
「斗法丹药」栏专注自动回血/回蓝；「通用消耗品」栏还可装阵法与符箓补强战局。
阵法偏持续辅助：{{item:item.juling-formation-disk|聚灵阵盘}} 全队回蓝，{{item:item.tianlei-formation-disk|天雷阵盘}} 受击概率降雷伤；符箓为瞬发特化：{{item:item.leiji-talisman|雷击符}} 无施法前摇，PVP 抢先手极强。
translation:
The "Duel Pills" bar handles automatic HP/MP recovery, while the "General Consumables" bar can also hold Formations and Talismans to turn the tide.
Formations provide sustained support: {{item:item.juling-formation-disk|Spirit-Gathering Formation Disk}} restores MP for the whole party, and {{item:item.tianlei-formation-disk|Heavenly Thunder Formation Disk}} has a chance to strike attackers with lightning when hit. Talismans are instant-cast: {{item:item.leiji-talisman|Lightning Strike Talisman}} has zero cast wind-up, making it deadly for seizing the initiative in PVP.

zh_source: 遭遇强敌或修士斗法前，务必在通用栏配好阵盘与瞬发符箓。
translation: Before facing tough foes or dueling other cultivators, always equip Formation Disks and instant Talismans in your General bar.

zh_source: 战斗消耗品：斗法丹药 vs 通用位
translation: Combat Consumables: Duel Pills vs. General Slots

zh_source:
所有生活行动除产出与技艺经验外，都会稳定积累丰厚的「底蕴」。
执行 {{action:cultivation.draw-qi|引气入体}} 等打坐修炼时，底蕴会以 3 倍速高速转为真实修为，兼修生活绝不拖慢破境。
translation:
In addition to yields and Art EXP, all life actions steadily accumulate abundant "Foundation".
When meditating with actions like {{action:cultivation.draw-qi|Draw Qi Inward}}, Foundation converts into true Cultivation at 3x speed—practicing life arts never slows your realm breakthroughs.

zh_source: 先做百艺攒灵石与底蕴，再去 {{location:node.cloud-peak|云巅草庐}} 等高灵脉节点打坐消化。
translation: Build up Spirit Stones and Foundation via the Seven Arts first, then meditate at high-vein nodes like {{location:node.cloud-peak|Cloud-Peak Thatched Hut}} to convert it.

zh_source: 底蕴机制与打坐三倍提速

所有制造产物的基准价恒为原材料总和的 3 倍，秘法「化灵」再按成品价 3 倍回收为 {{item:currency.spirit-stone|灵石}}。
前期稳赚优选「采集 → 制造 → 化灵」全自动循环：例如炼成一枚 {{item:item.juling-formation-disk|聚灵阵盘}} 直接化灵，单件立得 1512 灵石。
translation:
Every crafted item's base value is always 3x the sum of its raw materials, and the Secret Art "Liquefaction" recycles finished goods into {{item:currency.spirit-stone|Spirit Stone}} at 3x their base value.
A reliable early-game profit loop is "Gather → Craft → Liquefy": for example, crafting a {{item:item.juling-formation-disk|Spirit-Gathering Formation Disk}} and liquefying it nets 1,512 Spirit Stones per piece.

zh_source: 搭配队列循环与自动移动即可一路无干预自动生财。
translation: Enable Queue Loop and Auto-Travel for a fully hands-free, self-sustaining income cycle.

zh_source: 化灵三倍回本与聚灵阵盘生财
双药栏、瞬发符箓阵盘、化灵三倍回本与底蕴 3x 转化。
translation: Dual consumable bars, instant Talismans/Formations, 3x Liquefaction returns, and 3x Foundation conversion.

zh_source:
生活（采集/炼丹/炼器/阵法/符箓/秘法）与战斗互不排斥、鼓励兼修；前期靠生活产出极易积累大量 {{item:currency.spirit-stone|灵石}}。
战斗需一定物资铺垫：建议先炼制 {{item:equipment.qingfeng-sword|青锋剑}} 并备好 {{item:item.zhixue-powder|止血散}} 等斗法药散再讨伐，避免裸打体验吃力。
translation:
Life arts (Gathering, Alchemy, Forging, Formation, Talisman, Secret Art) and combat complement each other; early life-art production is an easy way to amass {{item:currency.spirit-stone|Spirit Stone}}.
Combat requires preparation: craft an {{item:equipment.qingfeng-sword|Azure-Edge Sword}} and stock up on {{item:item.zhixue-powder|Hemostatic Powder}} before crusading, rather than fighting bare-handed.

zh_source: 前期物资未齐时先走生活行动攒装备与灵石，备战成型再切讨伐。
translation: When supplies are scarce early on, gather gear and Spirit Stones through life actions before switching to Crusades.

zh_source: 前期路线：生活先导与战斗节奏
translation: Early Route: Life Arts First, Then Combat

zh_source:
离线期间队列照常推进且无损耗，初始离线挂机上限 48 小时，按时上线收菜续接即可。
双核心资源：修为决定境界、战力与更高阶造物/穿装上限；{{item:currency.spirit-stone|灵石}} 可交易买全品物资并大幅加速修炼。
translation:
Your action queue progresses normally while offline with zero loss, up to an initial 48-hour offline idle cap—just log in periodically to collect yields and renew your queue.
Two core resources: Cultivation governs your Realm, combat power, and crafting/gear tier caps; {{item:currency.spirit-stone|Spirit Stone}} buys all supplies and greatly accelerates cultivation.

zh_source: 排好采集或修炼循环后安心下线，48 小时内上线均能完整收获。
translation: Queue up a Gathering or Cultivation loop and log off with peace of mind—log back in within 48 hours to claim full rewards.

zh_source:
开启队列右侧「循环」后，行动完成会自动补排至队尾不断档，而非直接停机。
开启「自动移动」后，队列轮到异地行动时自动赶往对应节点（如 {{location:node.yunxi-village|云溪村}} 赴 {{location:node.cloud-peak|云巅草庐}}）并接续执行。
translation:
Enabling "Loop" on the right of the queue re-adds completed actions to the end instead of halting.
Enabling "Auto-Travel" automatically moves you to the required node when a remote action comes up (e.g., from {{location:node.yunxi-village|Yunxi Village}} to {{location:node.cloud-peak|Cloud-Peak Thatched Hut}}) and resumes execution.

zh_source: 串行多地点采集、制造与打坐时建议双开循环与自动移动。
translation: Turn on both Loop and Auto-Travel when chaining multi-location gathering, crafting, and meditation.

zh_source: 队列效率：循环与自动移动
离线挂机上限、双核心资源、开局节奏与队列自动化。
translation: Offline idle cap, dual core resources, early pacing, and queue automation.

zh_source:
主力装备经「炼器」造出后，可在「技艺 → 秘法 → 强化」提高强化等级放大属性。
前期过渡装强至 +3 够用即可；18 级后升级节奏放缓，可重点冲 +7 至 +10 带来大幅属性跃迁。
translation:
After forging your main gear via Forging, go to "Arts → Secret Art → Enhance" to raise its enhancement level and amplify stats.
Enhancing transitional early gear to +3 is plenty; once leveling slows after Lv.18, push +7 to +10 on long-term gear for massive power spikes.

zh_source: 前期勿在低级装上死磕高强，把灵石与强材留给 18 级后的长线装备。
translation: Avoid over-investing in low-level gear early—save Spirit Stones and enhancement materials for post-Lv.18 equipment.

zh_source:
境界决定可穿戴装备阶数、制造门槛与特质点数上限，每次破境均稳步提升基础属性。
达到凡人巅峰「叩天门」且修为攒满即可在内视开启「开天门」抽灵根；不满意可用「逆天改命」重抽直至合意。
translation:
Your Realm determines equippable gear tiers, crafting thresholds, and Trait point caps, with every breakthrough steadily raising base stats.
Upon reaching the Mortal peak of "Knocking at Heaven's Gate" with full Cultivation, enter Introspection to perform "Opening Heaven's Gate" and draw your Spirit Root. Unhappy with the result? Use "Defy Fate" to reroll until satisfied.

zh_source: 逆天改命消耗底蕴，配合 {{item:item.reverse-fate-pill|逆命丹}} 可将单次底蕴消耗降至 5%。
translation: Defying Fate consumes Foundation—using {{item:item.reverse-fate-pill|Reverse-Fate Pill}} reduces the Foundation cost per reroll to 5%.

zh_source: 境界突破与开天门·灵根重塑

前中期六维对战力影响极大：生活按动作加对应六维经验，战斗则获等量于修为的六维经验并依所选内功比例增减。
内功定六维倾斜与特殊战效，术法按槽位顺序施放；注意 {{ability:ability.palm-lightning|掌心雷}}、{{ability:ability.tide|潮汐}} 等 0CD 技能若放前排会导致连续施法、彻底跳过普通攻击。
translation:
The Six Dimensions heavily impact early-to-mid combat power: life actions grant corresponding Six-Dimension EXP, while combat grants Six-Dimension EXP equal to Cultivation, scaled by your equipped Internal Art.
Internal Arts define Six-Dimension scaling and passive effects, while Spells cast in slot order. Beware: 0-CD skills like {{ability:ability.palm-lightning|Palm Lightning}} or {{ability:ability.tide|Tide}} in front slots will cast endlessly and skip basic attacks completely.

zh_source: 物理普攻流切勿误带 0CD 术法，其余流派也避免置入前几个优先槽位。
translation: Physical basic-attack builds must never equip 0-CD Spells, and other builds should avoid placing them in the first few priority slots.

zh_source: 六维属性、内功与功法搭配
translation: Six Dimensions, Internal Arts & Ability Loadouts

zh_source: 开天门灵根、六维与 0CD 技能避坑、装备强化梯度。
translation: Heaven's Gate Spirit Roots, Six Dimensions, 0-CD skill pitfalls, and gear enhancement tiers.

zh_source:
消耗 {{item:item.awakening-stone|觉醒石}} 抽取特质，各特质按强度占用不同点数，总点数随境界增长。
觉醒石源于妖兽掉落 {{item:item.storage-bag.broken|破损的储物袋}} 与商店 {{item:item.gongde|功德}} 兑换；功德不宽裕时，建议每日只买特惠 100 功德（限 1）与 300 功德（限 1）两档。
translation:
Consume {{item:item.awakening-stone|Awakening Stone}} to draw Traits. Each Trait costs points based on its strength, and your point cap grows with your Realm.
Awakening Stones drop from monsters in {{item:item.storage-bag.broken|Broken Storage Bag}} and can be bought with {{item:item.gongde|Merit}} in the Shop. When Merit is tight, stick to the daily discounted 100-Merit (limit 1) and 300-Merit (limit 1) packs.

zh_source: 商店每日刷新的 100 与 300 功德折扣档最具性价比，适合长线囤石。
translation: The daily 100-Merit and 300-Merit discounted packs offer the best value for long-term Awakening Stone stockpiling.

zh_source: 觉醒石获取与每日功德精打细算

前期尚难成型时优先塞满「数值型」特质，直接拉高即时攻防与刷怪稳定性。
理解深入后可搭「机制型」：如组队脆皮输出带 {{trait:trait.bukandaowo|看不到我}} 开局防集火；或配 {{trait:trait.xuyi|蓄意}} 降双抗提血量与回复，挨打叠满后爆发反打乃至击溃敌方修士。
translation:
Early on before builds come online, fill your slots with "Stat-Based" Traits to directly boost attack, defense, and farming stability.
Later, experiment with "Mechanic-Based" Traits: squishy party DPS can run {{trait:trait.bukandaowo|Can't See Me}} to avoid opening focus fire, or pair {{trait:trait.xuyi|Calculated}}—sacrificing resistances for HP and regen—to stack up under fire and unleash a devastating counter-burst.

zh_source: 数值保下限、机制定上限，可随副本或斗法目标随时切换特质组。
translation: Stats secure your floor while mechanics define your ceiling—swap Trait presets anytime for dungeons or duels.

zh_source: 特质流派：数值直推 vs 机制构筑
translation: Trait Builds: Raw Stats vs. Mechanics

zh_source: 觉醒石渠道、每日低价功德档与数值/机制构筑策略。
translation: Awakening Stone sources, daily Merit bargains, and stat vs. mechanic Trait strategies.

zh_source:
节点内建有全服修士共建维护的「公共建筑」（可在「地图 → 附近 → 建筑」查看明细）。
公共建筑可为同地全部玩家提供修炼加速、生产加成或疗愈等常驻增益。
translation:
Nodes feature "Public Buildings" constructed and maintained by all cultivators on the server (view details under "Map → Nearby → Buildings").
Public Buildings grant persistent buffs—such as cultivation speedups, production bonuses, or healing—to everyone at that node.

zh_source: 长线挂机或打坐前先查看节点建筑加成，挑顺手灵地落脚。
translation: Check a node's building bonuses before settling in for a long idle session or meditation.

zh_source:
大地图点击节点即可规划路线前往，不同地图产出专属灵材与妖兽。
开启地图「斗法」后会与同图同样开启斗法的玩家随机遭遇，胜方可直接夺取败方 20 分钟暂存收益。
translation:
Click any node on the World Map to plot a route; different maps yield exclusive spirit materials and monsters.
Enabling "Duel" on the map lets you randomly encounter other Duel-enabled cultivators on the same map—the victor claims 20 minutes of the defeated player's pending yields.

zh_source: 只想安心挂机发育时注意关闭斗法开关，防 20 分钟收获被截。
translation: If you just want peaceful idle farming, keep Duel toggled off so your 20-minute yields aren't plundered.

zh_source:
在「同道 → 队伍」可组建或加入队伍，默认 3 人、最高支持 5 人编制；目标设「讨伐」且全员到场后自动开打。
组队能压低寻怪间隔并小幅增多怪物：适合越阶打高难图拿稀有掉落，但可轻松单刷的低难图单人收益反而更高（寻怪时间决定上限）。
translation:
Form or join a party under "Companions → Party" (3 members by default, up to 5). Once the target is set to "Crusade" and all members are present, combat begins automatically.
Parties shorten monster-search intervals and slightly increase spawns—ideal for punching above your weight in tough maps for rare drops. On easy maps you can solo-clear quickly, solo yields remain higher since search time caps output.

zh_source: 秒刷简单图建议单人吃满独享；冲高难与稀有掉落再集结组队。
translation: Solo easy maps to keep all loot to yourself; form a party when pushing high-tier zones and rare drops.

zh_source: 自由斗法 20 分钟掠夺、公共建筑与组队人数收益权衡。
translation: 20-minute open Duel plunder, Public Buildings, and party size vs. yield trade-offs.

zh_source: 悬停高亮词条看详情 · 点击地点直达大地图
translation: Hover highlighted terms for details · Click locations to jump to World Map

zh_source:
初入太初仍有诸多门道待解：灵石生财路线、0CD 技能防误装、特质流派抉择与组队收益取舍，皆已整理成册。

Yunxi Village abounds with Qi-Condensing Grass.

zh_source: 凝气草采集需要一些时间，完成后会自动进入下一环。

zh_source: 点击「规划路线」，为回村做准备。

zh_source: 抵达云溪村后引导自动继续。

zh_source:
跳过后引导将立即结束，剩余的阶段赠送与完成奖励会直接发放到你的行囊。

Skipping ends the tutorial immediately, and all remaining stage and completion rewards will be sent straight to your bag.

zh_source: 点击「规划路线」，为赶路做准备。

zh_source:

Click "Cloud-Peak Thatched Hut" on the map.

zh_source: 山高路远，抵达云巅草庐后自动继续引导。
translation: The mountain road is long. The tutorial will resume upon arrival at Cloud-Peak Thatched Hut.
Click "Depart" to return to Yunxi Village.

zh_source:
修炼有成，该回村一试身手了。
点击地图上的「云溪村」。
translation:
Your cultivation has borne fruit; time to test your skills back in the village.
Click "Yunxi Village" on the map.

zh_source: 归途之中，抵达云溪村后自动继续引导。
translation: On the road home. The tutorial will resume upon arrival at Yunxi Village.

zh_source:

Click "Next" to begin Step 1.

translation: A furious burst of flame that scorches a thousand miles.
Unbroken swordplay, each strike linked to the next.

zh_source: 存神内视，万虑皆空。上乘修仙冥想法，神识出窍，洞察天机，术法威能大增。
translation: Guard the spirit and gaze inward until all worldly thoughts vanish. A supreme meditative art that projects Divine Sense to fathom heaven's secrets, greatly amplifying spell potency.

zh_source: 身轻如燕，踏雪无痕。吐纳轻灵之气，游走闪避，疾步如风。
translation: Light as a swallow, leaving no trace on snow. Breathe in nimble Qi to weave, evade, and stride like the wind.

zh_source: 燃血为薪，力可崩山。魔道刚猛心法，彻底献祭生机气血，换取撼地狂力。
translation: Burn blood as kindling to unleash mountain-shattering might. A fierce demonic internal art that sacrifices vitality for earth-shaking power.
Heaven sends down sweet dew, nourishing all in silence.

zh_source: 重云压城阙，掌落万敌崩。
translation: Heavy clouds crush the city walls; a single palm strike shatters ten thousand foes.
A heavy blade cleaves the air, splitting a mountain in one stroke.

zh_source: 赤焰狂飙席卷四野，烈火焚身引燃魂魄，余烬久烧不息。
translation: A crimson gale sweeps the battlefield, scorching flesh and igniting the soul with lingering embers.

zh_source: 炼精化气，舍形求真。玄门速成秘法，将肉身本源精气全数转化为境界修为。
translation: Refine essence into Qi, casting aside form to seek truth. A swift orthodox secret art that converts bodily essence into pure Cultivation.
Nine-heavens thunder descends with ten-thousand-fold majesty.

zh_source: 力蛮如牛，不尚机巧。淬炼一身蛮力与筋肉，专修刚猛武道。
translation: Brute force like an ox, scorning petty tricks. Temper raw strength and sinew in the way of unyielding martial might.
A clap of thunder bursts from the sleeve at a palm's flick.

zh_source: 悍勇刀势横扫全体敌阵，随即自身踏入「移形」并蓄起五重「势不可挡」护体霸气，起始减半所受伤害且每秒削减一重。
translation: Sweep all foes with a ferocious blade, then enter Shifting Form and gather 5 stacks of Unstoppable aura, halving incoming damage at first and shedding 1 stack per second.
A formation-breaking tune that rouses the army's might.

zh_source: 清平一曲起，枯木又逢春。
translation: As the serene melody rises, withered trees meet spring anew.

zh_source: 清心寡欲，灵台空明。涤荡凡思杂念，凝练神识，专精术法奥义。
translation: Calm the heart and curb desire until the spirit terrace shines clear. Purge stray thoughts to refine Divine Sense and master arcane spells.

zh_source: 轻吟楚辞山鬼灵祝，降下漫天碧水灵露滋养全体友方，持续疗愈周身气血。
translation: Chant the Mountain Spirit's sacred hymn, calling down azure spirit dew to nourish and steadily heal all allies.

zh_source: 身剑合一化电刺出。未负「移形」时借剑势遁入移形；若起手已怀「移形」，则消耗移形强行锁定破绽，击杀目标立即重置本技冷却且不再重复施加移形。
translation: Become one with the sword and thrust like lightning. If not in Shifting Form, slip into it with the blade's momentum; if already in Shifting Form, consume it to lock onto a flaw—killing the target resets cooldown immediately without reapplying Shifting Form.

zh_source: 一剑贯星斗，余势仍未休。
translation: One sword pierces the stars, its lingering force unbroken.

zh_source: 崩碎自身护体罡气，化坚甲为无边煞力，舍身狂暴，撼天裂地。
translation: Shatter your own protective astral Qi, turning solid armor into boundless fiendish fury to shake heaven and earth.

zh_source: 怒喝惊四野，引敌向吾身。
translation: A thunderous roar startles the wilds, drawing every foe's wrath.

zh_source: 引动枯木神雷劈落，随机击中至多两名敌方并令其周身麻痹，迟滞身法步履。
translation: Summon Withered-Wood Divine Thunder to strike up to 2 random enemies, numbing their limbs and slowing their movement.

zh_source: 引动幽深潮汐暗涌，巨浪滔天，席卷全体敌阵。
translation: Stir deep abyssal tides into towering waves that crash across all enemies.

zh_source: 筋骨如铁，刀枪不入。横练筋骨皮肉，铸就铜浇铁铸之躯。
translation: Sinews like iron, impervious to blade and spear. Temper skin, bone, and flesh into an unyielding frame of bronze and iron.

zh_source: 一呼一吸，气行周身。道家入门心法，调和经脉，固本培元。
translation: With every breath, Qi courses through the body. An introductory Daoist internal art that harmonizes Meridians and steadies the root.

zh_source: 气行任督，周天不息。玄门正宗护体心法，灵息搬运，周天循环，坚不可摧。
translation: Qi circulates endlessly through Ren and Du vessels. An orthodox defensive art that cycles spirit breath in an unbreakable microcosmic orbit.

zh_source: 玄元一气，六合归真。玄门上乘筑基心法，采天地纯粹玄元之气，周天百骸形神兼修，无偏无颇。
translation: Primordial Qi unites the six directions in truth. A superior Foundation internal art that draws pure heaven-earth Qi to cultivate body and spirit in perfect balance.

zh_source: 缩地成寸，腾挪移形。引符阵庇佑全体友方周身气机游离，步虚避锋。
translation: Shrink the earth to an inch and shift through space. Channel a talisman array to cloak all allies in elusive Qi, stepping through void to evade blades.

zh_source: 剑光凝霜斩碎玉。若身负「移形」，则借势化态为「踏云」，凌空掠影横扫全体敌阵。
translation: Frost-condensed sword light cleaves jade. While in Shifting Form, morphs into Cloud-Treading to sweep all enemies from midair.

zh_source: 隔空种下无形毒炎咒印，不造成直接破体伤害，命中后于敌方肺腑间引燃大量业火余烬。
translation: Plant an invisible venom-flame curse from afar. Deals no direct impact damage, but ignites abundant Karmafire Embers within the target's vitals on hit.

zh_source: 双方各剩 1 人时生效
translation: Active when 1 combatant remains per side

zh_source: 持续 {seconds} 秒 · 叠层刷新
战斗中所获六维根基经验，将按照此心法标注的六维百分比进行增幅获取。
translation: Six-Dimension Root Base EXP earned in combat is boosted by the percentages shown on this Internal Art.

zh_source: 按敌方额外存活数叠层
受击叠层 · 跨波清除
translation: Stacks on hit · Cleared between waves

zh_source: 每 5 秒回复 {n} 点气血
每层每秒回复 {n} 点气血
每 5 秒回复 {n} 点灵力
伤害型技能命中翻倍并在每次施放后消耗 1 层（叠加刷新时长，效果不随层数叠加）
translation: Doubles damaging skill Accuracy and consumes 1 stack per cast (stacking refreshes duration; effect does not scale with stacks)

zh_source: 每 [[{n} 点已损气血]] [[1 层]]
若击杀目标，余势贯穿至另一名敌人造成同等伤害，至多贯穿{n}次
translation: On kill, excess force chains to another enemy for equal damage, up to {n} times

zh_source: 每秒获得 {n} 最大生命的威胁
translation: Gains Threat equal to {n} Max HP per second

zh_source: 引动敌意向己，获得 {n} 点威胁值
目标中途死亡则连击停止
translation: Stops if the target dies mid-combo

zh_source: 并对命中目标施加 {composition} 的 {buff}
translation: and applies {composition} of {buff} to hit targets

zh_source: 若起手已持有[[移形]]且本次击杀目标，则立即重置冷却且不再施加[[移形]]
translation: If [[Shifting Form]] was active on cast and this skill kills the target, immediately resets CD without reapplying [[Shifting Form]]

zh_source: 若起手未持有[[移形]]，则自身获得 {buff}
translation: If [[Shifting Form]] is not active on cast, gains {buff}
Morphs into {name} while [[Shifting Form]] is active

zh_source: 施放后移除 1 层[[移形]]
translation: Consumes 1 stack of [[Shifting Form]] after cast

zh_source: 生命值百分比最低的队友
乌铁细研入破碎灵核精微粉末，涂敷器胎抚平微瑕，助益强化。
translation: Dark iron finely ground with shattered spirit core dust; coated onto gear to smooth flaws and aid enhancement.

zh_source: 以草木精华拌和桃木细粉精制盘香，幽香定神，百工动作如飞。
translation: Coil incense blended from herbal essence and fine peach-wood dust. Its calming scent steadies the mind and hastens craft.

zh_source: 赤铜精砂借水灵原核澄洗淬炼，渗入法器回路稳固胚胎，强化无忧。
translation: Fine crimson copper sand washed in a water spirit core, sealing artifact circuits for worry-free enhancement.

zh_source: 伴灵精华与水灵原核水乳交融，吞服引天地灵气汇入紫府汪洋。
translation: Spirit-companion essence fused seamlessly with a water spirit core, drawing heaven-earth Qi into the Purple Mansion.

zh_source: 道门初阶灵草嫩芽所萃伴灵精华炼就，温润固脉，生机绵绵。
translation: Refined from Daoist spirit-herb shoots and companion essence; gently steadies meridians and nurtures vitality.

zh_source: 以草木精华调和清晨甘露，顺脉调气，百脉流转自如。
translation: Herbal essence blended with morning dew to soothe meridians and let Qi flow unimpeded.

zh_source: 以凝气草与清澈晨露炼制而成的基础引气灵丹，可略微加快吐纳效率。
translation: A basic spirit pill brewed from Qi-Condensing Grass and clear morning dew, slightly boosting breathing efficiency.

zh_source: 以伴灵精华浸润引灵松芯，凝炼上乘灵香，香气通灵彻髓。
translation: Spirit-pine heartwood steeped in companion essence and refined into superior incense whose fragrance pierces marrow and soul.

zh_source: 以升级所需修为的底蕴强行凝丹，为逆天改命留下一次挣脱天命的余地。
translation: Forcibly condensed from Foundation equal to a level-up's Cultivation, leaving a chance to defy fate and break heaven's decree.

zh_source: 以草木精华配以粗韧狼皮胶熬制，金创敷之肉芽速生。
translation: Simmered from herbal essence and tough wolf-hide glue; seals blade wounds and knits flesh rapidly.

zh_source: 以草木精华与晨露炼制的调息灵丸，可抚平体内翻涌气血，加速灵力恢复。
translation: A breath-soothing pellet of herbal essence and morning dew that calms surging Qi-blood and speeds MP recovery.

zh_source: 以伴灵精华与伴灵花淬炼而成的通脉灵丹，药力直透经络百骸，大益周天行气。
translation: A meridian-clearing pill tempered from companion essence and flower; its potency pierces every channel to aid circulation.

zh_source: 研磨凝气草炼制而成的凡品止血散剂，可迅速闭合寻常外伤创口。
translation: Mortal hemostatic powder ground from Qi-Condensing Grass to swiftly close ordinary wounds.

zh_source: 在青云仙山各处搜寻妖兽踪迹，迎战山野灵物与守山妖兽。
translation: Track demon beasts across Qingyun Immortal Mountain, battling wild spirit creatures and mountain guardians.

zh_source: 在青云古道沿线搜寻凶兽踪迹——驿路苍狼、险栈暗涌、落石巨獠、古关暴猿，步步凶险。
translation: Hunt fierce beasts along Qingyun Ancient Trail—post-road wolves, cliffside currents, falling-rock tuskers, and ancient-pass apes.

zh_source: 深入星陨异境搜寻妖兽踪迹——界隙狼群、焦林火鸦、血池邪修、荒坑尸煞，各险地盘踞不同妖物。
translation: Venture deep into Starfall Domain—rift wolf packs, scorched-wood fire crows, blood-pool cultists, and wasteland corpse fiends.

zh_source: 踏入畸木焦林以北的雾梦大泽——荒径水傀、浅沼玄鳄、泽心鬼车与沉潭剑魄，逐险征伐。
translation: Step into the misty Wumeng Marsh north of the scorched woods—mire puppets, shallow-bog crocodiles, nine-headed ghosts, and sunken sword souls.

zh_source: 萃取伴灵花幽蓝灵机与清晨甘露融炼的纯净灵液。
translation: Pure spirit elixir distilled from the azure aura of Spirit-Companion Flowers and morning dew.

zh_source: 融合凝气草与清晨甘露萃取的草木生机精华。
translation: Vitality essence extracted by blending Qi-Condensing Grass with morning dew.

zh_source: 地火精炼赤铜矿石，去除顽石杂质。
translation: Smelt crimson copper ore with earthfire to purge stony impurities.

zh_source: 千锤百炼去除凡火杂质，精炼高纯乌铁。
translation: Hammer and temper dark iron through a thousand strikes to purge mortal slag.

zh_source: 萃取百年桃木纯阳精华凝聚为晶。
translation: Extract pure yang essence from century-old peach wood and condense it into crystal.

zh_source: 淬炼引灵松木凝结的青翠树芯灵晶。
translation: Refine verdant heartwood crystal condensed from Spirit-Drawing Pine.

zh_source: 吐纳周天，凝聚一缕灵气，增长修为与灵力。
translation: Circulate breath through the microcosm to gather a wisp of spirit Qi, increasing Cultivation and MP.

zh_source: 引天地之清气，炼肉身之精微，气沉丹田，化为精纯真元。
translation: Draw clear heaven-earth Qi to refine bodily essence, sinking it into the Dantian as pure True Yuan.

zh_source: 引气既入，凝于丹田元宫，周天自运，气血渐纯。
translation: Condense drawn Qi into the Dantian palace; as the orbit turns on its own, vitality grows ever purer.

zh_source: 以灵石为媒淬炼装备本体逐级铭纹，成败之间砥砺器物威能。
translation: Channel Spirit Stones to temper gear and inscribe runes tier by tier, honing its power through success and risk.

zh_source: 在落霞阳坡采伐带有微弱纯阳灵气的坚韧古桃木。
translation: Fell hardy ancient peach wood imbued with faint pure-yang Qi on Sunset Slope.

zh_source: 在畸木焦林采伐吸收星火异气的坚韧引灵松。
translation: Fell resilient Spirit-Drawing Pine infused with starfire Qi in the Twisted Scorched Woods.

zh_source: 破晓时分在漱玉溪边草木叶尖汲取纯净无根晨露。
translation: Gather pure, rootless morning dew from grass tips beside Jade-Wash Creek at dawn.

zh_source: 在腐生古冢死气聚集处采摘吸纳死气伴生的伴灵异花。
translation: Pluck rare Spirit-Companion Flowers nourished by gathering death Qi in the Decaying Mound.

zh_source: 在幽深背阴的百草谷采摘暗红的凡品凝气草。
translation: Pick dark-red mortal Qi-Condensing Grass in the shaded depths of Hundred-Herb Valley.

zh_source: 在荧石铜渊地底深处开采滚烫温热的赤铜矿石。
translation: Mine scalding-warm crimson copper ore from the depths of Fluorite Copper Abyss.

zh_source: 在清石水滩露天砂石层中开采沉重致密的乌铁原矿。
translation: Excavate dense, heavy dark iron ore from the open gravel beds of Clear-Stone Shoal.

zh_source: 在玄元门遗址深处的灵石矿脉中开采天然灵石。
translation: Extract natural Spirit Stones from veins deep within the Xuanyuan Sect Ruins.

zh_source: 以伥虎煞齿与兽骨匕合铸之凶煞短匕，出招暴烈。
translation: A vicious dagger forged from feral tiger fang and beast-bone blade, unleashing ferocious strikes.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮拼接缝制的护身短甲，结实耐磨。
translation: A sturdy protective vest stitched from hundred-tempered iron plates and beast hide.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核雕琢的灵水玉佩，回气绵绵。
translation: A spirit-water jade pendant carved from Peach-Wood Crystal and water core, steadily restoring Qi.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核浸润的灵丝道袍，波光流转。
translation: A spirit-silk Daoist robe steeped in Peach-Wood Crystal and water core, shimmering like ripples.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与粗韧狼皮精制的妖狼头领皮冠，野性森寒。
translation: A fierce alpha-wolf hide cap reinforced with hundred-tempered iron, radiating wild chill.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与粗韧狼皮缝制的紧身行猎长裤，迅捷如风。
translation: Fitted hunting trousers sewn from hundred-tempered iron and tough wolf hide, swift as the wind.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与粗韧狼皮配妖狼獠牙打磨的扳指，暗蕴杀伐。
translation: A thumb ring polished from hundred-tempered iron, wolf hide, and demon-wolf fangs, humming with killing intent.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与粗韧狼皮裁制的贴身轻甲，质轻且韧。
translation: Light fitted armor tailored from hundred-tempered iron and tough wolf hide, supple yet resilient.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与残魄灵符重铸九节杖升华的祥云长杖。
translation: An auspicious cloud staff reforged from a Nine-Section Staff with Spirit-Pine Crystal and remnant-soul talisman.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸束发巾打造的金光护盔。
translation: A gleaming protective helm reforged from a headband using Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸兽牙坠炼制的灵戒。
translation: A spirit ring refined from a fang pendant with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以坠星妖核与朝元杖合灵之天星法杖，神通疾转。
translation: A star-infused dharma staff forged by fusing a Fallen-Star Demon Core with an Origin-Facing Staff.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与重甲厚皮缝缀的沉铁护腿，下盘如岳。
translation: Heavy iron greaves layered with hundred-tempered iron and thick armor hide, rooting your stance like a mountain.

zh_source: 以古战残刃与破罡剑熔炼重铸之古修残锋，疾风出招。
translation: An ancient cultivator's remnant blade reforged from Ancient War Shard and Astral-Breaker Sword, striking like a gale.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽骨打制的贴身轻匕，反握藏锋。
translation: A light close-quarters dagger forged from hundred-tempered iron and beast bone, balanced for reverse grip.

zh_source: 以陨星破片与踏风裤熔铸之流线战胫，行动极速。
translation: Streamlined war greaves smelted from Meteorite Shards and Wind-Treader Pants for extreme action speed.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核烧制的小瓷瓶，盛满晨露甘露。
translation: A small porcelain flask fired from Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores, brimming with morning dew.

zh_source: 以暴猿煞心、金背猿骨与锁子重甲精炼铸就的重铠，坚韧反震。
translation: Heavy armor forged from Fierce Ape Heart, Golden-Back Ape Bone, and Chainmail Heavy Armor, unyielding and rebounding.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与火羽重铸甘露瓶而成的回春铜铃。
translation: A rejuvenating bronze bell reforged from a Sweet-Dew Flask using Spirit-Pine Crystal and fire feathers.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核炼制的静心道巾，轻柔透气。
translation: A serene Daoist headscarf refined from Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores, light and breathable.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮编织的武行束发带，束发齐整。
translation: A martial headband woven from hundred-tempered iron and beast hide to keep hair neatly bound.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核炼制的道家法杖，通体温润。
translation: A Daoist dharma staff crafted from Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores, warm to the touch.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮剪裁的贴身练功裤，绑腿利落。
translation: Fitted training trousers tailored from hundred-tempered iron and beast hide with neat leg wraps.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与残魄灵符重铸桃木符雕琢的聚灵玉佩。
translation: A spirit-gathering jade pendant recarved from a Peach-Wood Talisman with Spirit-Pine Crystal and remnant talisman.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核雕琢的灵木法杖，引动水脉灵气。
translation: A spirit-wood staff carved from Peach-Wood Crystal and water core, channeling water-vein Qi.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸轻皮甲锻造的破罡轻甲。
translation: Astral-piercing light armor reforged from Light Hide Armor with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核灵丝编织的法带，静心凝神。
translation: A dharma sash woven from Peach-Wood Crystal and water-core spirit silk, calming the mind.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与火羽重铸行气裤织就的飘逸下裳。
translation: Flowing lower vestments rewoven from Qi-Circulation Pants with Spirit-Pine Crystal and fire feathers.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核精制的碧泉古琴，清音洗心。
translation: An emerald-spring zither crafted from Peach-Wood Crystal and water core; its clear notes wash the heart.

zh_source: 以祭司煞骨与子午冠精雕之幽冥道冠，幽冥护体。
translation: A nether Daoist crown carved from Priest Fiend-Bone and Meridian Crown, shielding the wearer in shadowy Qi.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核雕琢的御水法符，增幅术法。
translation: A water-commanding dharma charm carved from Peach-Wood Crystal and water core, amplifying spells.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与火羽重铸素麻袍织就的不染法衣。
translation: A dustless dharma robe rewoven from a Plain Hemp Robe with Spirit-Pine Crystal and fire feathers.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽骨打造的厚重朴刀，势大力沉。
translation: A heavy broadsword forged from hundred-tempered iron and beast bone, delivering crushing blows.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与坚岩獠齿打造的阔刃大刀，势如开山。
translation: A broad heavy saber forged from hundred-tempered iron and rock-hard tusks, mighty enough to split stone.

zh_source: 融入赤铜精与兽牙重铸青锋剑而成的破罡利刃。
translation: A sharp astral-piercing blade reforged from an Azure-Edge Sword with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽骨精铸的三尺长剑，剑身青光澄澈。
translation: A three-foot longsword finely forged from hundred-tempered iron and beast bone, gleaming with clear azure light.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核磨制的法珠，可助法诀流转。
translation: A dharma orb polished from Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores to smooth spell circulation.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮精裁的轻巧短甲，护心御风。
translation: A light, well-tailored short cuirass of hundred-tempered iron and beast hide, guarding the chest against wind and blade.

zh_source: 以伥虎妖丹与桃木符融铸之灵气古佩，通灵聚宝。
translation: An ancient spirit pendant fused from Tiger Demon Core and Peach-Wood Talisman, attuning to treasures.

zh_source: 以百炼铁穿系凶兽尖牙制成的项坠，野性十足。
translation: A fierce pendant strung with sharp beast fangs on hundred-tempered iron.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮编织的武行束发头巾，简朴干练。
translation: A simple, practical martial headscarf woven from hundred-tempered iron and beast hide.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与残魄灵符重铸素心琴升华的幽林松风琴。
translation: A secluded pine-wind zither elevated from a Pure-Heart Zither with Spirit-Pine Crystal and remnant talisman.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与兽皮编织的宽松道袍，宽袖飘逸。
translation: A loose Daoist robe woven from Peach-Wood Crystal and beast hide with billowing sleeves.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与重甲厚皮锁接而成的连环重甲，坚固难摧。
translation: Heavy interlocking chainmail forged from hundred-tempered iron and thick armor hide, nigh indestructible.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核制成的七弦古琴，音质清越素雅。
translation: A seven-stringed zither of Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores, clear and graceful in tone.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸疾行裤剪裁的轻灵武行短裤。
translation: Nimble martial shorts reforged from Swift-Stride Pants with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与破碎灵核雕琢的辟邪木符，草木幽香内蕴。
translation: An evil-warding wooden talisman carved from Peach-Wood Crystal and shattered spirit cores, holding a subtle herbal scent.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸扎口裤打造的防冲撞胫甲。
translation: Impact-resistant greaves reforged from Cuff-Bound Pants with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与重甲厚皮精制的防御圆盾，沉雄如岳。
translation: A round defensive shield of hundred-tempered iron and thick armor hide, imposing as a peak.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮铆接而成的精铁小盾，轻便顺手。
translation: A handy small buckler riveted from hundred-tempered iron and beast hide.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与火羽合铸的三足丹炉，炉温恒定宜于炼丹。
translation: A three-legged pill furnace forged from hundred-tempered iron and fire feathers, holding steady heat for alchemy.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽骨打制的炼器火钳，隔绝烈焰牢夹灵胚。
translation: Forging tongs of hundred-tempered iron and beast bone that block searing flames and grip spirit blanks.

zh_source: 以桃木与桃木晶扎就的小小阵旗，插落之处地气听调。
translation: A small formation flag bound from peach wood and crystal; wherever planted, earth Qi obeys.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与桃木打制的采药小铲，入土三分而不伤灵根。
translation: A herb-gathering trowel of hundred-tempered iron and peach wood that digs deep without harming spirit roots.

zh_source: 以百炼精铁与碎灵核锻造的开山灵镐，落凿之处矿脉微鸣。
translation: A mountain-opening pick forged from tempered iron and spirit core shards; ore veins hum at every strike.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与碎灵核合铸的强化重锤，落锤器物灵光内蕴。
translation: An enhancement hammer forged from hundred-tempered iron and spirit core shards, infusing gear with inner radiance.

zh_source: 以桃木为杆、残魄灵符凝锋制成的画符灵笔，落纸符意自成。
translation: A talisman brush with a peach-wood shaft and remnant-talisman tip; runes form naturally on paper.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与兽皮缝制的练功长裤，利于周天行气。
translation: Training trousers sewn from Peach-Wood Crystal and beast hide, aiding Qi circulation.

zh_source: 融入赤铜精与兽牙重铸精铁盾而成的赤铜战盾。
translation: A crimson-copper war shield reforged from a Refined Iron Shield with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 融入赤铜精与兽牙重铸兽骨匕而成的破罡短刃。
translation: An astral-piercing short blade reforged from a Beast-Bone Dagger with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与重甲厚皮锻制的沉铁护额，护持命门。
translation: A heavy iron brow-guard forged from hundred-tempered iron and thick armor hide to shield the vital gate.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与坚岩獠齿精铸的沉铁长剑，剑体沉凝。
translation: A heavy iron longsword forged from hundred-tempered iron and rock-hard tusks, weighty and poised.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与残魄灵符重铸桃灵珠而成的曜光法珠。
translation: A radiant dharma orb reforged from a Peach-Spirit Bead with Spirit-Pine Crystal and remnant talisman.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸百衲甲编缀而成的赤铜鳞甲。
translation: Crimson-copper scale armor reforged from Patchwork Armor with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以百炼铁与兽皮剪裁的利落劲装短裤，便于翻山越岭。
translation: Trim martial shorts tailored from hundred-tempered iron and beast hide, ideal for scaling peaks.

zh_source: 以赤铜精与兽牙重铸劲风巾混织的利落束发巾。
translation: A crisp headscarf rewoven from a Brisk-Wind Headband with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 融入赤铜精与兽牙重铸劈山刀而成的煞气重刀。
translation: A fierce heavy saber reforged from a Mountain-Cleaver Blade with Refined Crimson Copper and beast fangs.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核细密灵丝织成的宽松道裤，通经活络。
translation: Loose Daoist trousers woven from Peach-Wood Crystal and fine water-core silk, clearing the channels.

zh_source: 以灵松晶与残魄灵符重铸混元巾炼制的玉质道冠。
translation: A jade Daoist crown refined from a Primordial Scarf with Spirit-Pine Crystal and remnant talisman.

zh_source: 炼制开宗立派与迁宗所用的令牌。
translation: A token forged for founding a Sect or relocating its grounds.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与粗韧狼皮为基，篆刻迷踪乱神符印，云雾蒸腾惑敌视线。
translation: Inscribe mind-clouding maze runes upon peachwood crystal and coarse wolf hide, raising swirling mists to befuddle foes.

zh_source: 以桃木晶与水灵原核为引，刻录九霄引雷神纹，阵起引天雷殛敌。
translation: Channel peachwood crystal and primordial water core to engrave Nine-Heavens Thunder-Calling runes, summoning heavenly lightning upon activation.

zh_source: 以百炼铁融炼兽血残骨，布设血煞炼魔阵纹，以敌煞血反哺己身。
translation: Fuse tempered iron with beast blood and bone shards to carve a Blood-Fiend Refining Formation that feeds off slain foes' malice.

zh_source: 以桃木晶为枢、破碎灵核为眼，篆刻聚灵阵纹于阵盘之上，布下后绵绵汇聚方圆灵机。
translation: Using peachwood crystal as the pivot and a shattered spirit core as the eye, engrave spirit-gathering runes that endlessly draw ambient Qi.

zh_source: 以神识推演残缺功法残卷，寻绎其中大道真意。
translation: Deduce missing passages from fragmented ability scrolls with Divine Sense to uncover the true essence of the Dao.

zh_source: 以秘法逆转铸器铭纹，按配方返还原生材料。
translation: Reverse-forge weapon inscriptions with secret arts to reclaim raw materials according to the original recipe.

zh_source: 以秘法真火萃取物品灵蕴，化为本源灵石。
translation: Refine an item's spiritual essence with secret true fire, distilling it into pure Spirit Stones.

zh_source: 以桃木晶为引，朱砂走笔勾勒雷纹，绘成一击即发的木行雷击灵符。
translation: Guided by peachwood crystal, trace cinnabar thunder runes in a single stroke to craft a hair-trigger Wood-element lightning talisman.

zh_source: 沿已规划的山道前往目标地点。
translation: Follow the charted mountain trails toward your destination.

zh_source: 接引地脉之火铸就的炼丹暖阁，药香弥漫，炉火温平，便于就地开炉炼药。
translation: A warm pavilion fed by earth-vein flames, steeped in herbal aroma with steady hearthfire for on-site pill refining.

zh_source: 以煞骨为桩、妖核为眼布下的镇魔大阵，阵成之处魔气受缚，群妖气血神通皆被阻尼压制。
translation: A grand sealing array anchored with fiend bones and demon cores, binding demonic Qi and suppressing monsters' HP and spells.

zh_source: 引赤铜玄火构筑的淬灵地穴，灵气凝重炽热，专用于熔灌灵材为法宝开光强化。
translation: A spirit-quenching cavern lit by crimson-copper mystic fire, brimming with dense heat to infuse treasures and unlock their radiance.

zh_source: 深嵌地脉的玄铁锻打密室，火膛赤红，冷潭如镜，可供修士熔炼锻打法宝。
translation: A subterranean mystic-iron smithy with blazing hearths and mirror-still quenching pools for smelting and forging artifacts.

zh_source: 刻满周天星宿与八卦流转的青石高台，修士登台可演算阵纹灵轨，炼制玄妙阵盘。
translation: A bluestone terrace carved with celestial constellations and eight-trigram circuits, allowing cultivators to chart rune paths and craft disks.

zh_source: 修士伐木采药的驻地工坊，晾晒架与置木棚一应俱全，便利四方采伐采集。
translation: A field workshop for lumbering and herb-picking, outfitted with drying racks and timber sheds for effortless gathering.

zh_source: 接引天地清气凝聚而成的纳灵大阵，阵内灵气氤氲，在此地交锋可迅速纳气回元。
translation: A spirit-drawing array channeling pure heaven-and-earth Qi; fighting within its misty veil rapidly restores MP.

zh_source: 以灵草茎秆编织的打坐蒲团，四周布下简易聚灵阵纹，盘坐其上可安心纳气。
translation: A meditation cushion woven from spirit-grass stalks, ringed by simple spirit-gathering runes for serene Qi absorption.

zh_source: 开采地脉矿石与灵晶的原矿工棚，配备坚固石磨与风箱，便利金石挖掘。
translation: A quarry shed built over mineral veins, equipped with heavy stone mills and bellows to aid ore and crystal extraction.

zh_source: 以青木灵力勾勒的生息大阵，阵光所及草木逢春，在阵中交锋可源源温养肉身气血。
translation: A life-giving array traced in verdant wood Qi; where its light shines, flora revives and combatants steadily mend their flesh and HP.

zh_source: 辟邪沉香木筑就的静心书斋，案头朱砂与狼毫清灵温润，专供修士静心落笔绘制灵符。
translation: A tranquil study built of warded agarwood, stocked with pure cinnabar and wolf-hair brushes for undisturbed talisman inscription.
The grand hall where sect elders and disciples convene.

zh_source:
晶棱含光，灵韵内藏。
蕴含纯净天地灵气的六角晶石，光华内敛。
translation:
Faceted crystal holding inner light.
A hexagonal crystal infused with pure heaven-and-earth Qi, its luster softly veiled.

zh_source:
白虎裂风煞，森齿刃如锋。
以山林凶兽伥虎口中森白利齿打磨而成的副手短匕，寒芒淬血，暴烈无匹。
translation:
White Tiger rends the gale with razor fangs.
An off-hand dagger ground from the pale fangs of a fierce spectral tiger, quenched in blood-chill malice.

zh_source:
百衲联皮布，缝缀成坚甲。
多层坚韧粗布与兽皮拼接缝制的护身短甲，结实耐磨。
translation:
Patchwork hide and cloth, stitched into sturdy mail.
A short cuirass sewn from layered coarse cloth and beast hide, tough and enduring.

zh_source:
碧波凝翠佩，静心拂俗尘。
采自落石险隘深涧的灵水玉佩，佩之如沐清泉，宁心静气，回气绵绵。
translation:
Azure-wave jade calms the heart and sweeps away worldly dust.
Carved from spirit-water jade found in Falling-Rock Gorge, bathing the wearer in clear spring serenity and steady Qi recovery.

zh_source:
碧水盈盈，灵光内敛。
浸润山涧水灵原核之气的丝织道袍，波光流转，御气行云。
translation:
Clear waters brim with veiled spirit light.
A silk Taoist robe steeped in mountain-stream water cores, shimmering like flowing waves to ease Qi circulation.

zh_source:
狼毫束顶，目光如电。
以古道妖狼头领顶皮精制之武冠，狼毫直竖，野性森寒。
translation:
Wolf bristles crown the brow; gaze sharp as lightning.
A martial cap crafted from the alpha demon wolf's crown pelt, bristling with untamed ferocity.

zh_source:
狼皮紧裹，腾挪自如。
鞣制狼皮制成的紧身行猎长裤，利于绝壁奔行与险道纵跃。
translation:
Snug wolfskin, swift in every leap.
Fitted hunting trousers of tanned wolf hide, built for scaling sheer cliffs and dashing down perilous trails.

zh_source:
狼牙嵌骨戒，煞气暗藏锋。
采古道妖狼尖锐獠牙配沉铁打磨的扳指，触体微凉，暗蕴杀伐戾气。
translation:
Wolf fang set in bone; malice hides a keen edge.
An archer's ring wrought from ancient-trail wolf fangs and heavy iron, cool to the touch yet humming with slaughter.

zh_source:
整张狼革裁就，动如疾风。
采整块粗韧妖狼外皮缝制的贴身皮甲，质轻且韧，拳脚迅疾。
translation:
Cut from a single wolf pelt, swift as a gale.
A fitted vest stitched from coarse demon-wolf hide, light and supple for rapid strikes.

zh_source:
松芯为杖，云聚朝元。
引灵松树芯雕琢的长杖，杖头盘旋如祥云聚顶。
translation:
Pine heartwood staff, clouds gathering at the crown.
A long staff carved from Spirit-Guiding Pine core, its finial swirling like auspicious clouds.

zh_source:
赤金覆首威自生。
赤金铜精打磨而成的全护铁盔，金光内敛，威风凛凛。
translation:
Crimson gold crowns the head, radiating quiet majesty.
A full iron helm burnished with crimson copper essence, gleaming with restrained authority.

zh_source:
赤纹绕指龙吟细。
赤红铜精打磨而成的指环，戒面铭刻着古朴赤龙纹样。
translation:
Crimson patterns coil the finger with a faint dragon's hum.
A ring forged from crimson copper essence, engraved with archaic red-dragon motifs.

zh_source:
星核倒悬灵潮涌，古木生辉引九霄。
以坠星古兽心脉妖核为枢机嵌于神木之巅，杖起之时沟通天地星海，诸法随心极速流转。
translation:
Inverted star-core stirs spirit tides; ancient wood shines to summon the Nine Heavens.
Set with a fallen-star beast's heart core atop sacred wood, this staff bridges the starry sea so spells flow at will.

zh_source:
叠甲护腿，下盘如岳。
层层铁叶缝缀包裹的武行护腿，稳固下盘，步履沉实。
translation:
Layered plates guard the shins, footing firm as a peak.
Martial greaves stitched with overlapping iron leaves, anchoring one's stance with heavy poise.

zh_source:
古战遗刃埋沙碛，断折难掩煞气森。
古战场出土的前代飞剑残刃，虽失剑尖，剑内铭刻的真元灵轨完好，出剑疾如残影。
translation:
An ancient relic buried in sand; broken, yet grimly fierce.
A shattered flying-sword remnant from an ancient battlefield; though missing its tip, its true-Qi circuits remain intact for phantom-fast strikes.

zh_source:
袖底藏锋，反握出奇。
百炼铁包兽骨打制的贴身轻匕，短小精悍，反握藏锋。
translation:
A blade hidden up the sleeve, striking from a reverse grip.
A compact dagger of hundred-forged iron clad in beast bone, built for sudden close-quarters strikes.

zh_source:
踏碎星辰履九霄，虚空渡步不沾尘。
九天陨星黑铁熔铸的流线战胫，表面流转暗红星火余温，身轻若燕，行动极速绝尘。
translation:
Tread shattered stars across the Nine Heavens; walk the void untouched by dust.
Streamlined greaves cast from meteoric black iron, glowing with ember-red starfire for effortless speed.

zh_source:
甘露一滴，枯木回春。
盛有清晨甘露的小瓷瓶，贴身携带可润养经脉。
translation:
A single drop of sweet dew revives withered wood.
A small porcelain vial holding morning dew; carried close, it gently nourishes the meridians.

zh_source:
猿骨铸龙脊，狂心御万击。
以金背巨猿金刚肋骨为主架、嵌狂暴煞心于护心宝镜之重装战铠，坚不可摧，震击反噬。
translation:
Ape ribs cast a dragon spine; wild fury withstands ten thousand blows.
Heavy armor framed with a Golden-Back Ape's adamantine ribs and a berserk fiend-heart chest mirror, unyielding and thorns-laden.

zh_source:
铃动回春，息续不绝。
镂刻回春符纹的铜铃，铃声清越，闻者气血渐苏。
translation:
The bell rings of spring's return, breath renewing without end.
A bronze bell etched with rejuvenation runes; its clear chime steadies and restores vitality.

zh_source:
素巾笼道髻，混元养太和。
道家修士常戴的素色道巾，轻柔透气。
translation:
Plain cloth binds the topknot; Primordial Chaos nurtures harmony.
A light, breathable Taoist headband worn by cultivators to keep their focus serene.

zh_source:
劲风束发，目朗神清。
细密皮革混织的武行束发带，束发齐整，目视精明。
translation:
Brisk winds bind the hair; eyes clear, spirit keen.
A martial headband woven of fine leather and thread, keeping hair tidy and gaze sharp.

zh_source:
九节灵杖出山竹。
老山竹根削成的九节法杖，通体油亮光滑。
translation:
A nine-joint spirit staff shaped from mountain bamboo.
Carved from aged mountain bamboo root, polished smooth and lustrous along all nine nodes.

zh_source:
轻裤疾行，纵跃随心。
贴身剪裁的武修练功裤，绑腿利落，步履如风。
translation:
Light trousers for swift strides and effortless leaps.
Tailored martial practice trousers with crisp leg wraps, letting the wearer move like the wind.

zh_source:
灵晶作佩，清气萦身。
青翠灵松晶雕琢而成的通灵玉佩，常年萦绕着淡淡清气。
translation:
Spirit crystal as a pendant, clear Qi wreathing the frame.
A jade pendant carved from verdant Spirit-Guiding Pine crystal, ever-wreathed in pure mist.

zh_source:
悬崖生古藤，纳水引灵泉。
取自落石险隘绝壁上的苍老灵藤，引动天地水汽，术法绵延。
translation:
Old vines cling to sheer cliffs, drawing water and spirit springs.
Harvested from cliffside vines in Falling-Rock Gorge, this staff channels ambient moisture for sustained sorcery.

zh_source:
破罡裂甲，身轻如燕。
细密锁环与兽皮交错编缀的轻便战甲，兼顾躯体护卫与拳脚发力。
translation:
Shatter astral guards and move light as a swallow.
Light mail woven of fine chain links and beast hide, balancing torso defense with agile strikes.

zh_source:
流云挽发，灵台空明。
以水丝灵线编织的束发法带，云纹飘逸，静心凝神。
translation:
Flowing clouds bind the hair; the spirit altar stays crystal clear.
A hair ribbon spun from water-silk spirit threads, adorned with drifting cloud motifs to calm the mind.

zh_source:
羽裳飘逸逐流云。
如流云般轻盈飘逸的羽丝下裳，随风而动。
translation:
Feathered skirts drift lightly, chasing flowing clouds.
An airy lower garment of feather-silk that ripples gracefully with every breeze.

zh_source:
水鸣涧壑底，清响洗凡尘。
嵌有水灵原核的素雅古琴，抚弄间若涧泉鸣玉，舒经活络。
translation:
Waters sing in deep ravines; clear notes wash away mortal dust.
An elegant zither inlaid with a primordial water core; its notes ring like jade springs, soothing the meridians.

zh_source:
幽骨聚煞寒透顶，神识澄明万法辟。
坠魔祭司魔煞头骨雕成的幽冥道冠，刺骨冰寒阻绝妄念，常驻幽冥壁障化解诸般煞气。
translation:
Nether bones gather chill malice; Divine Sense clears to ward off all spells.
Carved from a fallen demon priest's skull, its biting cold banishes delusion and upholds a barrier against dark miasma.

zh_source:
水华凝玉符，灵波润术芒。
以水灵原核雕琢的御水法符，佩于左臂，引动水脉灵韵增幅术法。
translation:
Water-blossom jade talisman; spirit ripples brighten every spell.
A water-mastering charm carved from a primordial water core, worn on the left arm to amplify spellcraft.

zh_source:
火羽织轻衣，尘垢不能侵。
混纺火羽与灵蚕丝织就的轻薄法衣，光洁如新，尘垢不沾。
translation:
Woven of fire-feather and silk, untouched by grime or dust.
A light dharma robe blended from fire feathers and spirit-silkworm thread, forever spotless.

zh_source:
重刀沉似岳，劈落断山峦。
沉重坚实的山林朴刀，刀背厚重，刀锋刃口雪亮。
translation:
A heavy blade like a mountain, cleaving peaks in twain.
A stout mountain cleaver with a thick spine and a gleaming, snow-bright edge.

zh_source:
刀重开绝壁，劈落碎层岩。
百炼沉铁融合凶兽重骨打造的阔刃大刀，刀锋厚重，悍勇无匹。
translation:
Heavy steel splits sheer cliffs and shatters layered rock.
A broad-bladed cleaver forged of hundred-tempered iron and heavy beast bone, fierce and unstoppable.

zh_source:
剑芒吞赤铜，锋出破罡气。
融入赤铜精淬炼的锋锐灵剑，剑芒吞吐，能破护体罡气。
translation:
Sword-light drinks crimson copper; one thrust pierces astral guards.
A razor-sharp spirit sword tempered with crimson copper essence, spitting sword-Qi that shatters protective barriers.

zh_source:
青锋映水，寒光澄秋。
青钢淬火锻造的三尺长剑，剑身青光如秋水澄澈。
translation:
Azure edge mirrors water; cold light clear as autumn.
A three-foot longsword forged from quenched azure steel, its blade gleaming like autumn waters.

zh_source:
桃木凝华，珠转法生。
老桃木灵芯磨成的法珠，握于掌心可助法诀流转。
translation:
Peachwood condenses radiance; as the bead turns, spells arise.
A dharma orb ground from aged peachwood heart, held in the palm to quicken incantations.

zh_source:
皮薄身轻，动如奔雷。
坚韧兽皮剪裁缝制的轻巧短甲，护心御风，便于拳脚发力。
translation:
Thin hide, light frame, swift as rolling thunder.
A supple leather cuirass tailored from tough hide, guarding the heart while leaving fists free to strike.

zh_source:
妖丹温润藏造化，古玉聚气引灵机。
嵌百载伥虎灵韵内丹于青铜古佩之中，通灵聚气，天地造化与异宝奇珍感知倍增。
translation:
A warm demon core hides fortune; ancient jade draws spirit Qi.
An antique bronze pendant inset with a century-old spectral tiger's core, heightening perception of rare treasures.

zh_source:
兽牙悬颈，野性随身。
以凶兽獠牙穿系而成的粗犷项坠，野性十足。
translation:
Beast fangs at the throat, untamed wildness at one's side.
A rugged necklace strung with fierce beast fangs, brimming with primal vigor.

zh_source:
束发整冠，行脚生风。
以细密麻布缝制的行脚束发头巾，简朴干练。
translation:
Bind the hair, set the crown, stride forth with the wind.
A plain yet practical traveler's headband sewn from fine hemp cloth.

zh_source:
抚弦生松涛，清响入云深。
千年引灵松精雕而成的古琴，抚弦宛如松涛阵阵。
translation:
Plucked strings stir pine waves; clear notes drift into high clouds.
A zither sculpted from millennial Spirit-Guiding Pine, echoing like wind through a pine forest.

zh_source:
宽袍麻袖不染尘。
以粗麻纺织的宽松道袍，宽袖飘逸，不染俗尘。
translation:
Wide sleeves of coarse hemp, unstained by worldly dust.
A loose Taoist robe woven from raw hemp, billowing softly in the mountain breeze.

zh_source:
铁环交错，重甲如山。
百炼铁环密密锁接而成的坚固连环甲，重岳沉凝，辟邪御力。
translation:
Interlocking rings, heavy as a mountain.
Dense chainmail forged of hundred-tempered iron rings, solid as a crag to ward off evil and blunt force.

zh_source:
桐木制琴，清音洗心。
以山中老桐木制成的七弦古琴，音质清越素雅。
translation:
Paulownia wood shaped into a zither; pure notes cleanse the heart.
A seven-stringed zither crafted from aged mountain paulownia, producing crisp, tranquil tones.

zh_source:
踏风逐月，步步生杀。
紧致利落的武行短裤，步法灵动，发力无滞。
translation:
Tread the wind, chase the moon; every step brings ruin.
Trim martial shorts tailored for agile footwork and unhindered power.

zh_source:
桃符雕古木，幽香辟不祥。
百年阳坡桃木雕刻而成的辟邪木符，散发着草木幽香。
translation:
Ancient peachwood carved with runes; faint fragrance wards off ill fortune.
A warding talisman whittled from century-old sun-slope peachwood, breathing a clean herbal scent.

zh_source:
铁胫护双腿，踏阵不可摧。
厚重的金属护腿胫甲，线条硬朗，坚不可摧。
translation:
Iron shins guard both legs, unbroken through any formation.
Heavy metal greaves with bold, angular plates, built to stand unyielding.

zh_source:
古铁裹坚木，沉雄不可破。
采古松坚木为底、外包沉铁重甲的防御圆盾，沉雄如岳，卸力消劲。
translation:
Ancient iron wraps stout timber, massive and unbreakable.
A heavy round shield backed with old pine and clad in dark iron, dispersing incoming force like a mountain.

zh_source:
方寸精铁，亦可挡锋。
百炼精铁与厚皮蒙合的轻盾，轻便顺手，护住身前要害。
translation:
A span of refined iron can still turn a keen blade.
A handy light shield of tempered iron faced with thick leather, guarding vital points.

zh_source:
三足小炉蕴灵火。
内嵌火羽的三足小丹炉，炉温恒定，丹药成色自此有凭。
translation:
A three-legged cauldron harboring spirit flame.
A compact alchemy furnace inlaid with a fire feather; its steady heat ensures consistent pill quality.

zh_source:
兽骨裹柄，铁钳夹灵。
兽骨作柄的百炼火钳，牢牢夹持赤红灵胚，隔绝烈焰煞气。
translation:
Bone-wrapped grip, iron tongs clamping spirit fire.
Hundred-forged tongs with beast-bone handles, gripping glowing blanks firmly while insulating against scorching heat.

zh_source:
旗落之处地气调。
桃木晶缀顶的小小阵旗，插落之处地气听调，阵势应手而成。
translation:
Where the banner falls, earth Qi obeys.
A small formation flag topped with peachwood crystal; planted in the soil, it bends local Qi to form arrays effortlessly.

zh_source:
铁刃桃柄，入土护根。
精铁锻刃、桃木为柄的采药小铲，入土三分而不伤灵根。
translation:
Iron blade, peachwood handle; digs deep yet spares the root.
A foraging trowel with a refined-iron blade and peachwood haft, unearthing herbs without harming spirit roots.

zh_source:
精铁开山，断石寻珍。
以百炼精铁锻身、碎灵核为心的开山灵镐，落凿之处矿脉微鸣。
translation:
Refined iron cleaves the peak, splitting stone for hidden gems.
A spirit pickaxe forged of tempered iron with a shattered core at its heart, humming softly near mineral veins.

zh_source:
灵芯淬刃，落锤生灵。
碎灵芯嵌心的百炼强化重锤，落锤器物灵光内蕴，强化事半功倍。
translation:
Spirit core tempers the edge; every hammer blow births radiance.
A heavy tempering hammer inlaid with a shattered spirit core, infusing gear with luster and boosting enhancement.

zh_source:
桃木为杆，魂丝聚锋。
桃木削杆、魂丝聚锋的画符灵笔，蘸朱砂落纸，符意一气呵成。
translation:
Peachwood shaft, soul-silk bristles.
A talisman brush of carved peachwood and spirit-silk; dipped in cinnabar, it channels rune intent in one stroke.

zh_source:
宽裤行气，周天自畅。
宽大舒适的练功长裤，透气吸汗，利于周天行气。
translation:
Loose trousers for smooth Qi flow through every circuit.
Comfortable, breathable practice trousers that keep meridians unhindered during cultivation.

zh_source:
赤铜覆面，不动如山。
赤铜厚甲拼合的护手重盾，盾面沉厚，可挡刀剑术法。
translation:
Crimson copper face, unmoving as a peak.
A heavy arm-shield plated in thick crimson copper, sturdy enough to turn blades and spells alike.

zh_source:
赤铜淬芒，嵌齿破罡。
融入赤铜精与兽牙锻造的破罡短刃，寒芒夺魄，破空穿甲。
translation:
Crimson copper gleams; inset fangs pierce astral guards.
A short guard-breaking blade forged of crimson copper essence and beast fangs, chilling the soul as it pierces armor.

zh_source:
古铁铸额，坚若磐石。
以厚重沉铁锻成的护额战带，稳固坚密，护持天灵。
translation:
Ancient iron casts the brow-band, solid as bedrock.
A heavy iron headband forged from dark ore, tightly guarding the crown.

zh_source:
古道寒铁铸，剑芒贯长虹。
采古道沉铁反复锻打的精良长剑，剑体沉凝，锋锐逼人。
translation:
Cold ancient-trail iron forged into a sword-beam spanning the sky.
A fine longsword repeatedly folded from dark trail iron, dense and bitingly sharp.

zh_source:
曜光蕴珠，法随念转。
灵松晶温养出的曜灵法珠，珠内光华流转不息。
translation:
Radiant light fills the orb; spells turn at a thought.
A luminous dharma bead nurtured with Spirit-Guiding Pine crystal, swirling endlessly with inner brilliance.

zh_source:
鳞甲如龙，赤光覆体。
片片赤铜精锁扣编缀而成的战甲，宛如赤色龙鳞覆盖。
translation:
Scales like a dragon, crimson light sheathing the body.
Battle armor interlocked with crimson copper essence scales, gleaming like a scarlet dragon's hide.

zh_source:
扎口轻绑踏千山。
下摆收口绑扎的武行布裤，便于翻山越岭与近身搏击。
translation:
Bound cuffs stride across a thousand peaks.
Cloth martial trousers tied snugly at the ankles for climbing ridges and close-range brawling.

zh_source:
截风断水，目若朗星。
以韧丝铜线混织的武修束发巾，紧致束发，目力明澈。
translation:
Sever the wind, cleave the stream; eyes bright as clear stars.
A martial headband woven of tough silk and copper wire, keeping hair tight and vision razor-sharp.

zh_source:
血槽暗隐斩煞锋。
百炼铁融合赤铜打造的厚重大刀，刀身隐泛暗红血槽。
translation:
A blood groove hides the fiend-slaying edge.
A heavy broadsword forged from tempered iron and crimson copper, etched with a dark-red fuller.

zh_source:
织水为锦，步踏清漪。
细密水蚕灵丝织成的宽松道裤，通经活络，术法自然流淌。
translation:
Woven of water brocade, stepping lightly over clear ripples.
Loose Taoist trousers spun from fine water-silkworm thread, opening meridians so spells flow naturally.

zh_source:
青玉雕冠，道韵涵光。
灵松晶雕刻打磨的青玉道冠，玉色温润清透。
translation:
Azure jade carved into a crown, cradling Daoist grace.
A jade coronet polished from Spirit-Guiding Pine crystal, warm and translucent.

zh_source:
地火苗藏玉管中。
封存在温玉小管中的一缕地脉火苗，静默跳动，热力含而不发。
translation:
Earth-fire spark sealed within a jade tube.
A wisp of subterranean flame preserved in warm jade, pulsing quietly with restrained heat.

zh_source: 撼地巨猿狂暴之力的精粹煞心，握在掌中仍有雄浑沉重的搏动之感。
translation: The berserk fiend-heart of an Earthshaker Giant Ape, still throbbing heavily in the palm.

zh_source:
天地通玄，宿慧初开。
蕴含先天气运的玄奥灵石。使用后可随机觉醒一项先天特质；若已拥有，则为该特质注入领悟经验，促其突破升阶。
translation:
Heaven and earth commune; dormant wisdom stirs.
A mysterious stone holding innate fortune. Use to awaken a random innate Trait, or infuse comprehension EXP into one you already possess to advance its tier.

zh_source:
幽蓝淬露，灵机盎然。
伴灵花与山泉淬炼出的幽蓝清液，纯澈剔透，灵机盎然。
translation:
Azure-tinted dew, brimming with living Qi.
A crystal-clear cerulean liquid distilled from Companion-Spirit Flowers and mountain spring water.

zh_source:
灵泉漱玉，幽蕊含光。
生长在悬崖灵泉旁的幽蓝野花，花瓣常年吞吐微光，暗香浮动。
translation:
Spirit springs rinse jade; shadowy petals hold a faint glow.
A cerulean wildflower growing beside cliffside springs, breathing soft luminescence and subtle fragrance.

zh_source:
山野遗白骨，密质胜坚石。
山野猛兽身上的坚硬兽骨，骨质密实惨白。
translation:
Bleached bones of wild beasts, denser than hard stone.
Sturdy, pale bones taken from fierce mountain beasts.

zh_source:
狼吻遗锋，坚利如铁。
荒野妖狼口中脱落的锋锐利齿，尖端坚硬如铁。
translation:
Wolf-maw fangs, keen and hard as iron.
Razor-sharp teeth shed by wilderness demon wolves, tipped with iron-hard enamel.

zh_source:
异兽遗革，坚韧如甲。
凡间野兽异变后留下的粗糙兽皮，皮质坚韧厚密。
translation:
Mutated beast pelt, tough as plate.
Coarse, thick hide left behind by mutated mortal beasts.

zh_source:
寒潭镇水鳞，玄甲抗千锋。
雾梦泽寒潭玄鳄颔下唯一倒生的玄黑护心逆鳞，水火难侵、坚胜精钢。
translation:
Cold-pool water-warding scale; dark armor defies a thousand blades.
The sole inverted heart-guard scale beneath a Wumeng Marsh Black Crocodile's jaw, impervious to water and fire and harder than refined steel.

zh_source:
断刃埋沙，杀气未销。
战场遗迹中出土的古战断刃，虽缺锋芒，却自有一股肃杀戾气。
translation:
Broken edge buried in sand, its killing intent undimmed.
An ancient war blade unearthed from ruins; though chipped, it still radiates grim ferocity.

zh_source:
灵核虽碎，微芒未泯。
初具灵机的精怪异兽体内残留的微弱灵核碎屑，晶芒微弱。
translation:
Though the core is shattered, a faint spark endures.
Crystal shards of a weak spirit core left inside fledgling spirit beasts.

zh_source:
灵脉赤铜含火纹。
伴生于灵脉浅层的赤红矿石，触手温热，断面隐现熔岩纹理。
translation:
Vein-born crimson copper veined with fire.
Reddish ore found along shallow spirit veins, warm to the touch with molten streaks inside.

zh_source:
淬灵生辉，抚平微瑕。
粗炼灵骨研磨而成的细腻白灰，涂敷于待强法器胎体之上，能稍稍平复材质内应力，使强化成功率提高三厘。
translation:
Quenching spirit brings luster and smooths tiny flaws.
Fine white ash ground from roughly refined spirit bone; dusted onto an artifact before enhancement, it eases internal stress and raises success rate by 0.3%.

zh_source:
乌金沉矿色如墨。
深山老矿采掘出的未淬原铁，色沉如墨，质地沉重坚硬。
translation:
Dark metal ore, black as ink.
Unrefined raw iron mined from deep mountain shafts, ink-black, heavy, and unyielding.

zh_source:
心脉结晶蕴狂澜。
异种古兽心脉凝成的晶核，内里流转着狂暴深邃的星陨灵息。
translation:
A heart-vein crystal cradling a raging tide.
A crystalline core condensed within an ancient exotic beast's heart, swirling with wild starfall spirit breath.

zh_source:
凶兽凝丹魄，煞纹隐血光。
深山凶兽体内凝结而成的浑浊兽丹，表面隐现血色煞纹。
translation:
Fierce beasts condense a core; fiend runes glint with blood-light.
A turbid beast orb formed inside deep-mountain predators, traced with faint crimson malice.

zh_source:
幽香定神，百艺自通。
凡间匠师采集静心草木精制的盘香，点燃后香烟凝而不散，使人神清气爽、手眼敏捷，百工技艺动作如飞。
translation:
Faint fragrance steadies the mind, making all crafts effortless.
Coil incense blended by mortal artisans from calming herbs; its lingering smoke sharpens focus and quickens every craft.

zh_source:
沉潭锁剑魄，蛟珠蕴真元。
雾隐剑魄温养百年而生的苍青宝珠，珠内剑意与泽水龙气交融吐纳，乃筑基重宝胚料。
translation:
Sunken pool locks sword-soul; flood-dragon pearl holds true Qi.
A celadon pearl nurtured for a century by mist-veiled sword souls, fusing sword intent with marsh-dragon Qi—a prime Foundation-tier treasure.

zh_source:
灵禽遗赤羽，星火缀翎梢。
灵禽异鸟身上的赤红翎羽，羽丝流转着点点火光星芒。
translation:
Spirit fowl shed crimson plumes, starfire tipping every barb.
Scarlet plumage from a spirit bird, shimmering with tiny sparks along its vanes.

zh_source:
轰炎一怒焚千里。
绘有炽烈火纹的朱红古卷，卷轴触手灼热。
translation:
A blazing burst scorches a thousand miles.
An ancient vermilion scroll painted with fierce flame runes, scorching hot to the touch.

zh_source:
剑势连绵，环环相扣。
记录连绵发力法门的武道典籍，图谱招式如水银泻地。
translation:
Sword momentum flows unbroken, link after link.
A martial tome recording continuous strike techniques, its diagrams flowing like quicksilver.

zh_source:
存神内视，万虑皆空。
绘有周身神煞穴位图的上乘神识真解，图文玄奥幽微。
translation:
Preserve the spirit, gaze inward; ten thousand thoughts fall still.
A superior Divine Sense manual mapping the body's spirit-fiend acupoints in profound detail.

zh_source:
身轻如燕，踏雪无痕。
羽绢抄录的轻身行气图，研读可御气轻身、踏草如飞。
translation:
Light as a swallow, leaving no trace upon the snow.
A feather-silk chart of lightness Qi circulation, teaching one to skim over grass as if flying.

zh_source:
燃血为薪，力可崩山。
散发刺鼻血腥气的赤褐残卷，记载魔道燃血极意，代价惊人。
translation:
Burn blood as fuel; gain strength to topple peaks.
A russet fragment reeking of iron, recording a demonic blood-burning secret art at a steep cost.

zh_source:
天降甘露，润物无声。
以清水写就的道门符诀典籍，纸页间隐有露珠滚动不落。
translation:
Heaven sends sweet dew, nourishing all in silence.
A Taoist talisman manual written in pure water, with dewdrops gliding across its pages.

zh_source:
重云压城，掌覆千军。
封皮如云海翻涌的玄妙道卷，内页以云篆古字书就。
translation:
Heavy clouds press the city; one palm covers a thousand troops.
A mystic scroll bound like surging clouds, inscribed inside with archaic cloud-seal script.

zh_source:
重剑无锋，大巧不工。
古朴厚重的蓝皮线装册页，字迹苍劲凌厉，隐有破空刀意。
translation:
A heavy blade has no edge; supreme skill looks artless.
A stout blue-bound booklet whose bold calligraphy hums with cleaving blade-intent.

zh_source:
烈风卷赤焰，炽火燃三魂。
五行火法上乘真解残卷，纸角焦灼犹存炽热火灵。
translation:
Fierce winds whirl scarlet flames, searing the three souls.
A fragmented tome of supreme Five-Elements fire sorcery, its charred corners still radiating heat.

zh_source:
炼精化气，舍形求真。
青玉简策编缀的古修遗典，记录舍弃肉身沉疴、精纯反哺修为之秘。
translation:
Refine essence into Qi; cast off form to seek truth.
Ancient jade slips detailing how to shed mortal dross and distill pure essence into Cultivation.

zh_source:
九霄雷落，万钧天威。
紫绫包边的上乘雷法真经，通篇流转着纯正的九霄雷意。
translation:
Nine-Heavens thunder falls with ten-thousand-fold might.
A purple-silk-edged thunder scripture pulsing with pure celestial lightning intent.

zh_source:
力蛮如牛，不尚机巧。
粗粝兽皮缝制的刚猛力修图谱，专修纯粹肉身蛮力。
translation:
Fierce as a wild ox, scorning all petty tricks.
A rugged beast-hide chart devoted to cultivating raw, unyielding physical strength.

zh_source:
袖中掌起一声雷。
以雷击木皮为封面的道门符诀典籍，字里行间隐有电芒跃动。
translation:
A clap of thunder rises from a sleeve-hidden palm.
A Taoist talisman scripture bound in lightning-struck bark, sparks dancing between its lines.

zh_source:
一往破千军，重甲无可当。
残损金箔刀谱，刀意刚猛几欲割裂掌纹。
translation:
Charge straight through a thousand troops; no heavy mail can hold.
A tattered gold-leaf saber manual whose fierce intent nearly slices the reader's palm.

zh_source:
一曲破阵壮军威。
铁划银钩写就的金戈战曲秘本，翻之顿觉杀伐之气扑面。
translation:
One battle-song shatters ranks and rouses martial might.
A secret war-score written in iron-sharp strokes, brimming with battlefield fury.

zh_source:
清平一曲起，枯木又逢春。
娟秀工整的琴谱仙卷，翻阅间隐有空灵琴音绕梁。
translation:
Clear Peace sounds, and withered trees bloom anew.
An exquisite zither score whose pages seem to echo with ethereal music.

zh_source:
清心寡欲，灵台空明。
素绢抄录的道门静心经卷，研读可洗涤心境杂念，专精术法。
translation:
Pure of heart, spare of desire; the spirit altar shines clear.
A plain-silk Taoist scripture that washes away stray thoughts to sharpen spellcraft.

zh_source:
山鬼含睇笑，芳草降神膏。
泛潮水痕浸润的古谱散章，墨色化作幽幽碧翠山林景。
translation:
The mountain spirit smiles demurely; fragrant herbs yield divine balm.
Damp-stained pages of an old score whose ink blooms into lush emerald woodland scenes.

zh_source:
电光火石间，步随剑影灭。
剑诀残叶，仅余一道凌厉至极的斜劈轨迹图。
translation:
In a flash of flint-spark, steps vanish with the sword's shadow.
A lone sword-manual leaf bearing only one razor-sharp diagonal slash trajectory.

zh_source:
一剑横空贯星斗。
以银丝装订的黄品箭道真解，星芒内蕴，锋芒毕露。
translation:
One sword sweeps the void to pierce the stars.
A Yellow-grade archery and thrusting manual bound in silver thread, gleaming with star-sharp intent.

zh_source:
碎罡崩甲，化煞成锋。
记载舍却护体罡气、以血勇换取杀伐之力的残页，笔锋凌厉如刀。
translation:
Shatter astral guards; turn malice into a keen edge.
A fragment recording how to forsake protective Qi and trade blood-valor for lethal power.

zh_source:
一声断喝，万敌回首。
记载引敌锁神之术的杂家古册，言语乖张奇诡。
translation:
One sharp shout turns ten thousand foes' heads.
An eccentric heterodox scroll detailing arts to provoke foes and lock their attention.

zh_source:
乙木隐霹雳，双雷震四方。
古雷法秘籍散落一角，指尖轻触犹能感到微微电弧酥麻。
translation:
Yin-Wood hides thunderbolts; twin lightning shakes the four quarters.
A stray corner of an ancient thunder tome that still tingles the fingertips with static.

zh_source:
潮起千重浪，汐落万顷涛。
记载水灵暗涌之道的上乘法诀残页，记录引动浪涛拍岸之法。
translation:
Tides surge in a thousand waves; ebb sweeps ten thousand billows.
A superior spell fragment charting how to stir surging water Qi and crash waves ashore.

zh_source:
筋骨如铁，刀枪不入。
铁线编织的硬气功册页，记录淬炼体魄与骨骼的横练之法。
translation:
Sinew and bone like iron, impervious to blade and spear.
Iron-thread-bound pages of hard Qigong, detailing external tempering of flesh and bone.

zh_source:
一呼一吸，气行周身。
记录道家入门呼吸吐纳法门的旧绢册页，可调和经脉、固本培元。
translation:
One exhale, one inhale; Qi courses through the whole frame.
An old silk booklet of introductory Taoist breathing exercises to harmonize meridians and steady one's root.

zh_source:
气行任督，周天不息。
金丝装订的正统道门心法，翻开隐有纯和清正的灵息周流。
translation:
Qi courses the Ren and Du channels in an endless micro-orbit.
An orthodox Taoist Internal Art bound in gold thread, radiating pure, balanced spirit breath.

zh_source:
玄元一气，六合归真。
玄门上乘筑基道书，采天地玄元始气以筑仙基，周天百骸形神兼修，无偏无颇。
translation:
Xuanyuan Primordial Qi unites the six directions in truth.
A supreme Foundation-building scripture drawing primordial Qi to forge an immortal base in perfect balance.

zh_source:
一步一重天，移形幻万千。
符箓玄门缩地移形秘典残卷，字迹虚实相生如幻影。
translation:
One step, one heaven; shifting forms spin ten thousand illusions.
A talismanic spatial-fold fragment whose ink shifts between solid and phantom.

zh_source:
剑出寒玉碎，身随流云移。
剑修一脉轻身斩玉秘传残页，墨痕如剑气斩玉而生。
translation:
Sword leaps, cold jade shatters; body drifts with flowing clouds.
A sword-sect lightness fragment whose brushstrokes cleave the page like sword-Qi.

zh_source:
无火自燃肺，暗焰烙灵台。
火咒秘卷残片，纸页中央焦黑却丝毫不损墨字。
translation:
Without fire, lungs burn; dark flames brand the spirit altar.
A fire-curse fragment charred black at its center, yet every inked character remains intact.

zh_source:
青烟袅袅起，引路觅灵踪。
以幽谷异草凝制的线香，点燃后青烟袅袅，香气沉静。
translation:
Blue smoke curls upward, guiding the search for spirit traces.
Stick incense pressed from secluded valley herbs; when lit, its calm smoke aids foraging.

zh_source: 撼地金背猿身上的粗大金骨，隐隐透出金属光泽，密度惊人。
translation: Thick golden bone from an Earthshaker Golden-Back Ape, gleaming faintly with astonishing metallic density.

zh_source: 邀友同道所得之功德，系于己身，不可易手。
translation: Merit earned by inviting fellow Daoists; bound to oneself and cannot be traded.

zh_source: 行善积德所凝的功德金光，可予同道交换流转。
translation: Golden light of Merit condensed from virtuous deeds, freely exchangeable among fellow cultivators.

zh_source:
九首哀鸣散，赤羽带残雷。
雾梦泽深处妖禽九首鬼车颈畔褪落的炽红长翎，隐带风雷毒炎灵韵。
translation:
Nine-headed lament scatters; scarlet plumes carry lingering thunder.
Blazing red neck-plumes shed by the nine-headed Guiche in deep Wumeng Marsh, humming with wind, thunder, and venom-fire.

zh_source:
金砂固胎，脉络贯通。
地脉灵矿反复澄洗析出的纯净金砂，淬炼时借火温渗入法器回路稳固胚胎，使强化成功率提高五厘。
translation:
Golden sand steadies the vessel and opens every circuit.
Pure golden sand washed from earth-vein ore; infused under hearth-heat, it stabilizes artifact cores and raises enhancement success by 0.5%.

zh_source:
吐纳六合，引气归元。
炼气期修士常备的基础灵丹，吞服即可助紫府吸纳天地灵气，加速真气周天搬运。
translation:
Breathe in the six harmonies; draw Qi back to the origin.
A staple Qi Refining pill that helps the dantian absorb ambient Qi and speed microcosmic circulation.

zh_source:
百草凝露，生机内蕴。
萃取百草朝露精粹而成的碧绿药露，香气清纯，生机内蕴。
translation:
Hundred herbs condense dew, brimming with inner vitality.
Emerald elixir distilled from morning dew and myriad herbs, crisp-scented and teeming with life.

zh_source:
黄芽初生，生机绵绵。
道门低阶灵草初生嫩芽淬炼的初品灵丹，温润柔和，可护持叩关修士经脉血肉不伤。
translation:
Yellow sprouts awaken, breathing endless vitality.
A mild entry-grade pill refined from tender spirit sprouts, gently shielding meridians and flesh during breakthroughs.

zh_source:
阵盘方寸聚灵潮。
桃木晶纹密布的方寸阵盘，置于身侧便展开无形聚灵小阵，四方灵气源源汇入主人体内。
translation:
An inch-wide disk gathers tides of spirit Qi.
A palm-sized disk etched with peachwood crystal runes; carried at one's side, it projects a subtle array that draws ambient Qi inward.

zh_source:
朱笔走雷纹，祭出召天霆。
朱砂勾勒雷纹的青色灵符，符面电光游走不散，祭出即唤木行天雷直击敌首。
translation:
Vermilion strokes trace thunder runes; cast it to summon heavenly wrath.
An azure spirit talisman inscribed with lightning sigils in cinnabar. Crackling arcs dance across its face, calling down Wood-aligned heavenly thunder upon the enemy's head.

zh_source:
星坠九霄，火痕犹烈。
自九天星穹坠落的大地陨铁碎片，表面布满星火熔铸的焦痕。
translation:
Fallen from the nine heavens, its starfire scars still burn.
A shard of celestial meteoric iron plunged from the firmament, its surface pitted with scorch marks forged by starfire.

zh_source:
幻烟缥缈影难寻。
流云玉石雕琢的方寸阵盘，布设后云雾缭绕全队身侧，步法虚实莫测，极大提升全队闪避游走之能。
translation:
Phantom mists swirl where no shadow can be traced.
An inch-wide formation disk carved from cloud-flow jade. Once deployed, mist coils around the entire party, making their footwork elusive and vastly boosting Evasion.

zh_source:
破晓凝珠润草尖。
破晓清晨凝结于山涧草木叶尖的无根甘露，清澈明净，不染尘埃。
translation:
Dawn condenses pearls upon the blades of grass.
Rootless sweet dew gathered from mountain herbs at daybreak—crystal clear and untouched by mortal dust.

zh_source:
调气顺脉，吐纳归心。
凡俗宗师自灵草中析出的清凉药散，服之平复翻涌气血，短时加快内劲运转与出手速度。
translation:
Calm the breath, soothe the meridians, and center the mind.
A cooling medicinal powder distilled from spirit herbs by mortal grandmasters. Taking it settles surging Qi and briefly hastens internal circulation and strike speed.

zh_source:
幽谷凝气，叶脉含朱。
生长在深山背阴处的暗红草药，叶脉如血丝交织，触之温润微凉。
translation:
Deep in shadowed valleys, crimson-veined leaves gather Qi.
A dark red herb growing on shaded mountain slopes. Its veins intertwine like threads of blood, cool yet gentle to the touch.

zh_source:
桃木凝晶琥珀光。
自百年老桃木中淬炼凝结的琥珀状灵晶，木香淡雅，通体晶莹。
translation:
Ancient peach wood condenses into amber radiance.
A translucent amber spirit crystal refined from century-old peach wood, exuding a delicate, calming fragrance.

zh_source:
向阳生古木，纯阳辟百邪。
向阳坡地采伐的百年老木，木质坚致密实，隐泛淡淡纯阳辟邪之意。
translation:
Born on sunlit slopes, pure Yang wards off all evil.
Century-old timber felled from sun-drenched ridges. Dense and resilient, it carries a faint aura of pure Yang.

zh_source:
丹光淡青，引气归真。
通体泛着淡青色光泽的初阶灵丹，散发着淡淡的草木清香。
translation:
Pale azure luster draws Qi back to its source.
An entry-grade spirit pill gleaming with a faint cyan sheen and a crisp herbal aroma.

zh_source:
青木凝芯，神通灵犀。
以道门百年青灵木芯配以清心灵露凝练的上乘线香，香气通灵彻髓，助叩关修士神识清澈、真气流转极速。
translation:
Azure wood core awakens the spirit to keen clarity.
Fine stick incense crafted from century-old azure spirit-wood heart and mind-clearing dew. Its fragrance pierces the marrow, sharpening Divine Sense and accelerating True Qi flow during breakthroughs.

zh_source:
地火炼赤铜，精纯流金泽。
赤铜经地火淬炼出的赤金铜精，光泽流转，致密纯正。
translation:
Earthfire tempers crimson copper into flowing gold.
Pure crimson copper essence smelted in subterranean flames—dense, lustrous, and free of slag.

zh_source:
凡火千锤炼，精铁去浊尘。
经凡火千锤百炼去除凡浊的原铁精料，铁质匀密坚固。
translation:
A thousand hammer-blows in mortal fire purge all dross.
Refined iron ore purified through relentless forging, yielding uniform, unyielding metal.

zh_source:
丹成可暂借一线天命。
色泽晦暗如墨的异种丹丸，入喉后逆冲经络，为逆天改命强行撕开一道缝隙。
translation:
A single pill borrows a sliver of Heaven's decree.
An anomalous, ink-dark pill. Once swallowed, it surges backward through the meridians, tearing open a narrow rift to defy one's fated destiny.

zh_source: 铁甲岩獠口中突出的灰白獠牙，质如岩石，沉重尖锐。
translation: A heavy, razor-sharp ash-white tusk jutting from an Iron-Plated Rock Boar, hard as solid stone.

zh_source: 古道妖狼身上剥取的坚韧外皮，毛刺如针，抗风挡煞。
translation: Tough pelt flayed from an ancient-trail demon wolf. Bristling with needle-like fur, it turns aside wind and baleful Qi.

zh_source:
魔煞侵苍骨，触手生冰寒。
历经魔煞侵蚀的苍黑异骨，触之刺骨冰寒。
translation:
Baleful Qi corrodes pale bone, chilling the hand that holds it.
Ashen-black bone steeped in demonic miasma, bitingly cold to the touch.

zh_source:
森白利齿浸血腥。
凶兽口中浸透血气的森白尖齿，锋刃如匕，透着阵阵森冷凶煞。
translation:
Stark white fangs drenched in bloodlust.
Pale, dagger-sharp fangs torn from a vicious beast, reeking of blood and chilling malice.

zh_source:
金创生肌，肉芽速生。
江湖名医以世俗奇药调配的暗青药膏，敷于创口可止血收口，凝结气罡防护周全。
translation:
Mends torn flesh and knits new sinew in haste.
A dark-green salve compounded by renowned mortal physicians. Applied to wounds, it stanches bleeding and condenses a protective Qi barrier.

zh_source:
丸转清凉顺气脉。
圆润微润的暗黄药丸，气味清凉醒脑。
translation:
A cool, soothing pellet that smooths the Qi channels.
A smooth, slightly moist dark-yellow pill with a crisp, refreshing scent.

zh_source:
朱砂斑驳符灵在。
残破泛黄的古旧符纸，朱砂符印斑驳，仍隐有灵力回荡。
translation:
Faded cinnabar still holds a lingering spark of spirit.
Tattered, yellowed talisman paper. Though its vermilion sigils are mottled with age, faint spiritual power still resonates within.

zh_source:
松芯凝翠藏灵风。
引灵松树芯灵髓凝出的青翠松晶，晶莹透亮，内含一缕清灵松风。
translation:
Emerald pine heart crystallizes a breath of spirit wind.
A translucent green crystal condensed from the core marrow of a Spirit-Drawing Pine, sealing a wisp of pure mountain breeze inside.

zh_source:
岁月磨蚀的低阶储物袋，袋口符印残缺，内有乾坤封存。
使用后可尝试破除残余封禁，获取封存于其中的灵石、功德与珍稀机缘。
translation:
A low-grade storage pouch worn by the years, its mouth-seal frayed yet still holding a pocket space within.
Use it to break the remaining seal and claim Spirit Stones, Merit, and rare fortunes.

zh_source: 附着泥沙硬石的厚重兽皮，粗砺坚固，胜似凡铁皮革。
translation: Heavy beast hide caked with grit and gravel—coarse, durable, and tougher than common iron-studded leather.

zh_source:
雷殛隐阵方寸间。
雷击木精雕的八角阵盘，铭刻引雷符纹。阵起之时，敌遭重创必招天雷反噬，唯施阵者须常注法力维系。
translation:
Heavenly thunder slumbers within an octagonal array.
An octagonal disk finely carved from lightning-struck wood and etched with thunder-drawing runes. Once active, heavily wounded foes suffer heavenly lightning backlash, though the caster must continually channel MP to sustain it.

zh_source:
轰炎一怒焚千里。
绘有炽烈火纹的朱红古卷，卷轴触手灼热。
translation:
A single burst of fury scorches a thousand li.
A crimson scroll painted with roaring flame motifs, searing hot to the touch.

zh_source:
剑势连绵，环环相扣。
记录连绵发力法门的武道典籍，图谱招式如水银泻地。
translation:
Sword momentum flows unbroken, link after link.
A martial manual recording continuous force-emission techniques, its illustrated forms flowing like quicksilver.

zh_source:
存神内视，万虑皆空。
绘有周身神煞穴位图的上乘神识真解，图文玄奥幽微。
translation:
Guard the spirit and gaze inward until ten thousand thoughts fade.
A supreme Divine Sense treatise charted with arcane acupoints, profound and subtle in every stroke.

zh_source:
身轻如燕，踏雪无痕。
羽绢抄录的轻身行气图，研读可御气轻身、踏草如飞。
translation:
Light as a swallow, treading snow without a trace.
A lightness-skill scroll copied onto feathered silk. Studying it lets one ride Qi and skim over grass like flight.

zh_source:
燃血为薪，力可崩山。
散发刺鼻血腥气的赤褐残卷，记载魔道燃血极意，代价惊人。
translation:
Burn blood as fuel to gain strength that topples mountains.
A tattered russet scroll reeking of pungent blood, chronicling a demonic blood-burning art with a terrifying price.

zh_source:
天降甘露，润物无声。
以清水写就的道门符诀典籍，纸页间隐有露珠滚动不落。
translation:
Heaven sends sweet dew to nourish all things in silence.
A Daoist talismanic manual written with clear water; droplets seem to roll endlessly across its pages without ever falling.

zh_source:
重云压城，掌覆千军。
封皮如云海翻涌的玄妙道卷，内页以云篆古字书就。
translation:
Lowering clouds press the city; one palm overwhelms an army.
A wondrous Daoist scroll bound like churning cloud-seas, its inner pages inscribed in ancient cloud-seal script.

zh_source:
重剑无锋，大巧不工。
古朴厚重的蓝皮线装册页，字迹苍劲凌厉，隐有破空刀意。
translation:
A heavy blade needs no edge; great skill appears artless.
An ancient, thread-bound blue volume whose vigorous, razor-sharp calligraphy radiates cutting intent.

zh_source:
烈风卷赤焰，炽火燃三魂。
五行火法上乘真解，教人汇狂飙与真火为一，焚尽群魔之躯壳与魂魄。
translation:
Fierce gales whip crimson flames, burning body and three souls alike.
A supreme Five-Elements fire treatise teaching how to fuse howling tempests with true fire to incinerate hordes of demons.

zh_source:
炼精化气，舍形求真。
青玉简策编缀的古修遗典，记录舍弃肉身沉疴、精纯反哺修为之秘。
translation:
Refine essence into Qi; shed the mortal husk to seek truth.
An ancient cultivator's legacy bound in green jade slips, revealing the secret of purging bodily dross to feed pure Cultivation.

zh_source:
九霄雷落，万钧天威。
紫绫包边的上乘雷法真经，通篇流转着纯正的九霄雷意。
translation:
Nine-heavens lightning descends with ten-thousand-fold majesty.
A supreme thunder-law scripture trimmed in purple silk, humming throughout with pure celestial lightning.

zh_source:
力蛮如牛，不尚机巧。
粗粝兽皮缝制的刚猛力修图谱，专修纯粹肉身蛮力。
translation:
Brute strength like a raging bull, scorning petty tricks.
A fierce body-cultivation manual stitched from coarse beast hide, dedicated to forging pure physical might.

zh_source:
袖中掌起一声雷。
以雷击木皮为封面的道门符诀典籍，字里行间隐有电芒跃动。
translation:
A clap of thunder erupts from a hidden sleeve.
A Daoist talismanic text bound in lightning-struck bark, with sparks dancing between the lines.

zh_source:
一往破千军，重甲无可当。
战阵悍刀大开大阖真义，教人在纵刀横扫之余蓄起护体霸罡。
translation:
Charge through a thousand foes; no heavy armor can withstand.
The true essence of battlefield saber-craft—sweeping wide while gathering an overbearing protective aura.

zh_source:
一曲破阵壮军威。
铁划银钩写就的金戈战曲秘本，翻之顿觉杀伐之气扑面。
translation:
One war-song shatters ranks and rouses martial might.
A secret martial score penned in iron-and-silver strokes; opening it unleashes a wave of killing intent.

zh_source:
清平一曲起，枯木又逢春。
娟秀工整的琴谱仙卷，翻阅间隐有空灵琴音绕梁。
translation:
A serene tune rises, and withered trees bloom anew.
An elegant, neatly penned zither score; reading it evokes ethereal notes lingering in the air.

zh_source:
清心寡欲，灵台空明。
素绢抄录的道门静心经卷，研读可洗涤心境杂念，专精术法。
translation:
Quiet the heart and desires until the spirit platform shines clear.
A Daoist meditation scripture copied on plain silk, washing away distracting thoughts to sharpen Spell mastery.

zh_source:
山鬼含睇笑，芳草降神膏。
符箓派古传群疗祝由典籍，以长歌引众泽甘露齐润四野众修。
translation:
The mountain spirit smiles among fragrant herbs, sending down divine balm.
An ancient talisman-sect healing chant that calls sweet dew across the field to mend all allies together.

zh_source:
电光火石间，步随剑影灭。
剑修上乘刺杀剑诀，善借「移形」之势一剑定乾坤、破敌即再起。
translation:
In a flash of flint and lightning, steps vanish with the sword's shadow.
A supreme assassination sword-art that rides the momentum of Shifting Form to strike decisively and reset upon slaying a foe.

zh_source:
一剑横空贯星斗。
以银丝装订的黄品箭道真解，星芒内蕴，锋芒毕露。
translation:
A single sword-beam cleaves the sky and pierces the stars.
A Yellow-grade archery and thrusting treatise bound with silver thread, brimming with starlight and sharp intent.

zh_source:
碎罡崩甲，化煞成锋。
记载舍却护体罡气、以血勇换取杀伐之力的体魄秘典，字字皆带煞意。
translation:
Shatter one's guard and forge baleful Qi into a sharper edge.
A physique manual recording how to cast aside protective aura and trade blood-courage for lethal might.

zh_source:
一声断喝，万敌回首。
记载引敌锁神之术的杂家古册，言语乖张奇诡。
translation:
One sharp shout turns ten thousand foes around.
An eccentric, miscellaneous scroll detailing the art of baiting enemies and locking their focus.

zh_source:
乙木隐霹雳，双雷震四方。
记载引动木系神雷并附带麻痹之力的古雷法全本，雷纹在纸面游走不绝。
translation:
Wood-born thunderclaps shake all four quarters with twin bolts.
A complete ancient thunder-law text summoning Wood-aligned divine lightning with paralyzing force; arcs of lightning course endlessly across its pages.

zh_source:
潮起千重浪，汐落万顷涛。
记载水灵暗涌之道的上乘法诀，引动潮汐怒涛，席卷全体敌阵。
translation:
Tides rise in a thousand waves; ebb-tides surge across ten thousand leagues.
A supreme Water-spirit manual that summons roaring tidal billows to sweep across the entire enemy formation.

zh_source:
筋骨如铁，刀枪不入。
铁线编织的硬气功册页，记录淬炼体魄与骨骼的横练之法。
translation:
Sinew and bone like iron, impervious to blade and spear.
A hard-Qigong manual stitched with iron wire, detailing methods to temper flesh and bone against all blows.

zh_source:
一呼一吸，气行周身。
记录道家入门呼吸吐纳法门的旧绢册页，可调和经脉、固本培元。
translation:
Inhale and exhale; Qi courses through the entire frame.
An old silk booklet of introductory Daoist breathing exercises to harmonize meridians and consolidate one's foundation.

zh_source:
气行任督，周天不息。
金丝装订的正统道门心法，翻开隐有纯和清正的灵息周流。
translation:
Qi cycles through Ren and Du vessels in an unbroken circuit.
An orthodox Daoist Internal Art bound in gold thread, radiating a pure, steady flow of spirit breath.

zh_source:
玄元一气，六合归真。
玄门上乘筑基道书，采天地玄元始气以筑仙基，周天百骸形神兼修，无偏无颇。
translation:
One primordial breath unites the six harmonies in truth.
A supreme Foundation-building Daoist scripture that draws primordial heaven-earth Qi to forge an immortal base, cultivating body and spirit in perfect balance.

zh_source:
一步一重天，移形幻万千。
符箓玄门缩地移形秘典，可引符光笼罩众修同气腾挪，避敌锋芒。
translation:
One step spans a heaven; shifting forms weave ten thousand illusions.
An arcane talismanic text of spatial contraction, shrouding allies in talisman light to warp together and evade lethal blows.

zh_source:
剑出寒玉碎，身随流云移。
剑修一脉轻身斩玉秘传剑谱，更载御风踏云、一剑横扫群敌之法。
translation:
Cold jade shatters at the sword's edge; the body drifts like flowing clouds.
An agile sword-sect manual teaching how to ride the wind and sweep through hordes of enemies in a single stroke.

zh_source:
无火自燃肺，暗焰烙灵台。
毒火道门绝学总纲，舍弃表皮灼伤转而直击心脉种下深重燃烧业火。
translation:
Lungs ignite without flame; dark fire brands the spirit platform.
A forbidden venom-fire canon that foregoes surface burns to plant deep, consuming karmic fire directly within the heart-meridian.

zh_source:
紫纹锁丹，药透经络。
丹面铭刻着细密紫纹的凝气灵丹，丹晕如雾缭绕。
translation:
Violet veins lock the pill; medicine pierces the meridians.
A Qi-condensing spirit pill etched with fine purple striations and wreathed in a misty medicinal halo.

zh_source: 潮汐之灵体内凝聚的纯净水精灵核，触手温润冰凉，蕴含微弱潮汐灵力。
translation: A pure Water-essence core condensed inside a Tide Spirit. Smooth and cool to the touch, it holds a faint pulse of tidal spirit power.

zh_source:
煞气滔滔噬生机。
浸透凶兽精血的森冷骨盘，以自身生机气血为引展开血海之阵，敌受创则煞气崩裂直刺其魄，并反哺自身。
translation:
Surging baleful Qi devours the living.
A chilling bone disk steeped in fierce beast blood. Channeling one's own vitality spreads a sea-of-blood array; wounded enemies trigger erupting malice that pierces their spirit and feeds vitality back to the caster.

zh_source:
绝壁生苍松，引风聚灵韵。
